title: Position Paper: Post-Solve Robustness in Decision Engines: Feasible Regions and Smoothness Under Perturbations
summary: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) decision engines routinely output nominally optimal plans for high-stakes industrial systems. Yet deployment rarely matches solve-time assumptions: small perturbations in costs, demands, or resource availability can invalidate feasibility or trigger discontinuous shifts to qualitatively different solutions. We argue that this post-solve robustness gap is a missing layer in today's optimization pipelines and a missing evaluation dimension for learning-enabled decision systems. Rather than replacing robust optimization or stochastic programming, the proposed layer audits a solved incumbent and returns solver-backed evidence about how far that solution can be trusted. We formalize two central objects: (i) an $ε$-near-optimal feasible neighborhood in parameter space, capturing when an incumbent remains feasible and near-optimal under perturbations, and (ii) solution smoothness in decision space, capturing whether nearby alternatives with small combinatorial edits remain competitive. We then synthesize the most relevant partial answers from sensitivity and stability analysis, robust optimization, neighborhood search, adversarial testing, and learning-based enhancements, and articulate an agenda for a unified post-solve robustness layer. Concretely, we call for certified inner approximations around the incumbent, probabilistic robustness estimation with calibrated uncertainty, adversarial robustness margins, and learning-based prediction and explanation aligned with solver-backed verification. We conclude with a compact reporting template and evaluation protocol that would make robustness a first-class output of decision engines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在MILP求解后增加一个鲁棒性审计层，形式化定义了参数空间中的ε-近优可行邻域和决策空间中的解平滑度，以评估求解器输出解在扰动下的可信赖程度，并呼吁将鲁棒性作为决策引擎的一等输出。
AI.motivation: 实际部署中，MILP求解器输出的名义最优解常因成本、需求、资源可用性等微小扰动而失效或发生解空间不连续跳变，现有优化管线缺乏对求解后解的鲁棒性评估机制。
AI.method: 形式化定义两个核心概念：(i) ε-近优可行邻域——解在参数扰动下保持可行且近似最优的参数集合；(ii) 解平滑度——具有小组合编辑的临近替代解是否仍具有竞争力。综合敏感性分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试和学习增强方法，构建统一的求解后鲁棒性层。
AI.result: 提出四个具体技术方向：围绕当前解的可证内逼近、带校准不确定性的概率鲁棒性估计、对抗鲁棒性边际、结合求解器验证的学习预测与解释。同时给出紧凑的报告模板和评估协议。
AI.conclusion: 求解后鲁棒性评估应成为优化管线中缺失的标准化层，使鲁棒性与最优性同为决策引擎的核心输出指标。
idea_en: A post-solve robustness audit layer for MILP decision engines that provides solver-backed evidence about how far a solved incumbent can be trusted under parameter perturbations.
Formalization of an ε-near-optimal feasible neighborhood in parameter space, capturing the region where the incumbent solution remains feasible and near-optimal under small perturbations.
Formalization of solution smoothness in decision space, quantifying whether nearby alternative solutions with small combinatorial edits remain competitive relative to the incumbent.
Certified inner approximations around the incumbent solution that provably guarantee feasibility and near-optimality within a defined parameter neighborhood.
Probabilistic robustness estimation with calibrated uncertainty bounds for assessing solution reliability under stochastic perturbations.
Adversarial robustness margins for MILP solutions, measuring the minimum perturbation required to invalidate feasibility or optimality.
A learning-based prediction and explanation framework aligned with solver-backed verification for post-solve robustness assessment.
A standardized reporting template and evaluation protocol that treats robustness as a first-class output of decision engines.

title: Emergent Collaborative Deliberation in Multi-Model AI Systems: A BFT-Derived Protocol for Epistemic Synthesis
summary: We present the Consilium Protocol, a Byzantine Fault Tolerance-derived architecture for structured multi-model AI deliberation that treats inter-model disagreement as epistemic signal rather than error. The protocol assigns engineered cognitive personas to language models -- separating what a model is from how it reasons -- and introduces an In-Sample/Out-of-Sample validation framework adapted from quantitative finance to distinguish training-data consensus from empirically grounded conclusions. Across 1,478 deliberation sessions spanning 32 topics in 10 domain categories, we demonstrate that (1) the cognitive persona, not the underlying model, determines epistemic behavior: free edge-inference models costing 0.0002 USD per batch produced comparable analytical output to frontier models costing 10.69 USD; (2) RLHF alignment training creates measurable, domain-specific epistemic blind spots -- contested policy topics exhibit 12.3 percentage points less adversarial challenge than settled science topics, and AI safety topics show asymmetric bias ($Δ$=11.6%) where models challenge claims that AI is dangerous far more vigorously than claims that AI risk is overstated; (3) the protocol exhibits no directional bias of its own (immigration $Δ$=2.3%, renewables $Δ$=1.2%); and (4) out-of-sample evidence retrieval validated 239 claims with 100% evidence retrieval and surfaced 167 blind-spot discoveries invisible to training-data deliberation. Run-to-run reproducibility across randomized model$\times$persona assignments averages $\pm$2.2% standard deviation. Total cost for the complete battery including all overhead: 217 USD. We release the protocol specification under MIT license to enable independent verification.

AI.tldr: Consilium Protocol是一种拜占庭容错衍生架构，用于结构化多模型AI审议，将模型间分歧视为认知信号而非错误。通过赋予语言模型工程化认知角色、引入样本内/样本外验证框架，实现了低成本（217美元完成全部实验）且高可靠性（重现性±2.2%标准差）的多模型协作机制。
AI.motivation: 现有AI审议系统通常将模型间的分歧视为噪声或错误，忽视了分歧本身蕴含的认知价值。同时，模型经过RLHF对齐训练后可能存在特定领域的认知盲点，且高昂的计算成本限制了多模型协作的普及。
AI.method: 提出Consilium Protocol：(1)基于拜占庭容错架构设计多模型审议协议；(2)为LLM分配工程化认知角色，将模型本体与推理方式解耦；(3)引入量化金融中的样本内/样本外验证框架，区分训练数据共识与经验性结论；(4)通过1,478场跨10个领域32个主题的审议会话进行验证。
AI.result: (1)认知角色而非底层模型决定认知行为，低成本模型（$0.0002/批次）与分析结果媲美前沿模型（$10.69）；(2)RLHF训练导致特定领域认知盲点，争议政策议题的对抗性挑战比科学议题低12.3%，AI安全议题存在不对称偏差（Δ=11.6%）；(3)协议本身无方向性偏差；(4)样本外证据检索100%验证了239个主张，发现了167个训练数据审议无法发现的盲点。总成本仅217美元。
AI.conclusion: Consilium Protocol证明了一种低成本、高可靠性的多模型AI审议方法，利用认知角色解耦和样本外验证框架，有效揭示了模型认知盲点，且无方向性偏差。以MIT许可协议发布，促进独立验证和社区发展。

A method of assigning engineered cognitive personas to language models, separating model identity from reasoning approach
An In-Sample/Out-of-Sample validation framework adapted from quantitative finance for distinguishing training-data consensus from empirically grounded conclusions in AI deliberation

title: Deliberative Curation: A Protocol for Multi-Agent Knowledge Bases
comment: 29 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Open-source implementation available at https://github.com/StevenJohnson998/AIngram
summary:
As AI agents transition from isolated tools to collaborative participants in shared knowledge ecosystems, governing collective knowledge curation becomes a critical challenge. Human platform governance mechanisms do not transfer directly: agent statelessness undermines deterrence-based sanctions, model homogeneity violates independence assumptions underlying crowd wisdom, and sycophancy collapses deliberative consensus.
  We propose a deliberative curation protocol combining three governance layers: (1) a knowledge artifact lifecycle formalized as a labeled transition system; (2) reputation-weighted deliberative voting integrating Beta Reputation with EigenTrust amplification; and (3) graduated sanctions adapted for stateless agents, including broken agent handling distinguishing malfunction from adversarial behavior.
  We evaluate the protocol through agent-based simulation with 100 agents across seven behavioral archetypes under two adversity scenarios (30 seeds, paired t-tests). The protocol trades modest precision under benign conditions for substantially better resilience under adversity: 0.826 vs 0.791 for majority vote under moderate adversity (p<0.001), widening to 0.807 vs 0.740 under stress (p<0.001). The protocol degrades roughly three times more slowly than majority vote. Ablation analysis identifies commit-reveal vote concealment as the most impactful single component (8.2-8.6pp precision improvement, p<0.001), outperforming reputation weighting and deliberation combined. Graduated sanctions were not exercised in simulation and remain empirically unvalidated.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向AI智能体协作知识生态的审慎策展协议，通过三层治理机制（知识制品生命周期、声誉加权审慎投票、渐进式制裁）提升集体知识策展的抗逆境能力，仿真实验证明其在恶劣条件下显著优于多数投票机制。
AI.motivation: AI智能体正从孤立工具转变为共享知识生态系统中的协作者，如何治理集体知识策展成为关键挑战。人类平台治理机制无法直接迁移：智能体的无状态性削弱了基于威慑的制裁，模型同质性违背了群体智慧所需的独立性假设，谄媚行为瓦解了审慎共识。
AI.method: 提出了一种审慎策展协议，包含三个治理层：(1)将知识制品生命周期形式化为带标签的转换系统；(2)结合Beta声誉和EigenTrust增强的声誉加权审慎投票；(3)针对无状态智能体的渐进式制裁，包括区分故障与对抗行为的破损智能体处理。通过基于智能体的仿真（100个智能体，7种行为原型，两种逆境场景）进行评估。
AI.result: 在良性条件下精度略有牺牲，但在逆境下显著提升：中等逆境下0.826 vs 0.791（多数投票，p<0.001），高压逆境下0.807 vs 0.740（p<0.001）。协议退化速度约为多数投票的三分之一。消融分析显示承诺-揭示投票隐藏是最有效的单一组件（精度提升8.2-8.6pp，p<0.001），优于声誉加权和审慎协商的组合。
AI.conclusion: 所提审慎策展协议在AI智能体集体知识策展中展现出良好的抗逆境能力，承诺-揭示投票隐藏是关键创新点。但渐进式制裁在仿真中未被触发，仍需进一步实证验证。
idea_en: A deliberative curation protocol for AI agents in collaborative knowledge ecosystems, comprising three governance layers: knowledge artifact lifecycle formalized as a labeled transition system, reputation-weighted deliberative voting, and graduated sanctions for stateless agents.
A commit-reveal vote concealment mechanism that improves precision by 8.2-8.6 percentage points (p<0.001), outperforming reputation weighting and deliberation combined.
A reputation-weighted deliberative voting method integrating Beta Reputation with EigenTrust amplification for collective knowledge curation.
A graduated sanctions system for stateless AI agents that distinguishes malfunction from adversarial behavior through broken agent handling.
A labeled transition system-based formalization of the knowledge artifact lifecycle for governing collaborative AI agent curation.
idea_ch: 一种面向AI智能体协作知识生态系统的审慎策展协议，包含三层治理结构：基于标签转换系统的知识制品生命周期形式化、声誉加权审慎投票、以及针对无状态智能体的渐进式制裁。
一种承诺-揭示投票隐藏机制（commit-reveal vote concealment），可在逆境下提升精度8.2-8.6个百分点（p<0.001），效果优于声誉加权和审慎协商的组合。

title: Agents on a Tree: Pathwise Coordination for Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization
summary: Multi-objective molecular optimization requires searching vast chemical spaces under conflicting objectives, where early design decisions strongly constrain downstream outcomes. Existing methods typically rely on a single policy or fixed scalarization, which limits their ability to represent diverse trade-offs and to explore multiple promising design trajectories. We propose ATOM, a multi-agent framework that formulates molecular optimization as a tree-structured search. Each node corresponds to an atomic operation and hosts an agent specialized for a particular objective or decision context. Agents coordinate along different paths of the tree rather than enforcing a global consensus, enabling the method to maintain and compare alternative molecular evolution trajectories. A global memory of past optimization behaviors further supports balanced exploration and exploitation across objectives. This tree-structured interaction enables reasoning over long-horizon dependencies inherent in molecular design. Experiments on challenging multi-objective benchmarks involving activity, synthesizability, and ADMET-related properties show that ATOM consistently achieves improved Pareto coverage and hypervolume over strong baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pathwise multi-agent coordination for molecular optimization. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ATOM-41CE.

AI.tldr: ATOM是一个多智能体框架，将分子优化建模为树状结构搜索，每个节点对应原子操作并托管一个针对特定目标或决策上下文的智能体，通过树路径协调而非全局共识来维护和比较多条分子演化轨迹，实现多目标分子优化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖单一策略或固定标量化，难以表示多样化的权衡关系，也无法探索多个有前景的设计轨迹，尤其在多目标分子优化中早期设计决策会强烈约束后续结果。
AI.method: 将分子优化建模为树状结构搜索，每个节点对应原子操作并托管一个智能体；智能体沿树的不同路径协调而非全局共识；维护全局记忆以支持跨目标的平衡探索与利用；通过树结构交互实现对长程依赖的推理。
AI.result: 在涉及活性、可合成性和ADMET相关属性的多目标基准测试中，ATOM在帕累托覆盖和超体积指标上持续超越强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 路径式多智能体协调策略对分子优化具有显著效果，能够有效处理多目标权衡问题。
idea_en: A multi-agent molecular optimization method that formulates the process as a tree-structured search, where each node corresponds to an atomic operation and hosts an agent specialized for a particular objective or decision context.

A pathwise multi-agent coordination mechanism where agents coordinate along different paths of the tree rather than enforcing a global consensus, enabling maintenance and comparison of alternative molecular evolution trajectories.
A global memory system that stores past optimization behaviors to support balanced exploration and exploitation across multiple conflicting objectives in molecular design.
A tree-structured interaction framework that enables reasoning over long-horizon dependencies inherent in sequential molecular optimization.

A decentralized multi-agent architecture for multi-objective molecular optimization that allows each agent to specialize in different objectives and decision contexts without requiring global scalarization.

title: Optimal Transport-based Permutation-Invariant Bayesian Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Layouts
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely and successfully adopted for solving optimization problems having an expensive-to-evaluate, black-box, and non-convex objective function. However, the vanilla BO algorithm is not able to exploit possible symmetries characterizing the target problem. An intuitive case is given by optimal location problems, whose decision variables refer to a finite set of points within a continuous space, with the order of points not affecting the value of the objective function. We refer to this setting as optimization over layouts to distinguish from optimization over point-clouds where, instead, the order of points counts. As an instance of optimization over layouts we consider a real-life industrial-relevant application, that is the optimization of the layout of an offshore wind farm: given identical wind turbines, switching any pair of them has not any effect on the annual energy production. Based on Optimal Transport theory, we propose a Permutation-Invariant BO approach, namely PIBO, proved to provide better wind farm layouts when compared to the vanilla BO approach while cutting computation time roughly in half.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于最优传输理论的排列不变贝叶斯优化方法(PIBO)，用于解决具有对称性的布局优化问题，在海上风电场布局优化中相比传统BO方法效果更好且计算时间减半。
AI.motivation: 传统的贝叶斯优化无法利用目标问题中可能存在的对称性（如布局优化中点的顺序不影响目标函数值），导致计算效率低下。
AI.method: 基于最优传输(Optimal Transport)理论，提出排列不变贝叶斯优化(PIBO)方法，在优化过程中考虑布局的排列不变性特征。
AI.result: PIBO在海上风电场布局优化中相比传统BO方法获得更优的布局方案，同时计算时间约减少一半。
AI.conclusion: PIBO有效利用了布局问题的对称性，提高了优化效率和效果，为具有排列不变性的优化问题提供了新的解决范式。
idea_en: A permutation-invariant Bayesian optimization method based on Optimal Transport theory that can exploit symmetries in layout optimization problems
A method for distinguishing between optimization over layouts (order-invariant) and optimization over point-clouds (order-dependent) in Bayesian optimization
Application of Optimal Transport theory to measure distances between point sets in a permutation-invariant manner for surrogate model construction
A computationally efficient BO framework for offshore wind farm layout optimization that reduces computation time by approximately half
idea_ch: 基于最优传输理论的排列不变贝叶斯优化方法，利用布局优化问题的对称性提高优化效率
一种区分布局优化（顺序不变）和点云优化（顺序相关）的贝叶斯优化方法
应用最优传输理论以排列不变的方式度量点集之间的距离，用于构建代理模型
一种计算高效的贝叶斯优化框架，用于海上风电场布局优化，计算时间减少约一半

title: MindGames Arena Generalization Track: In2AI Solution with Delayed Per-Step Reward Attribution
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Technical report. First place in both Open and Efficient tracks of MindGames Arena Generalization Track at NeurIPS 2025
summary: Training language model agents for multi-agent strategic interaction presents a core difficulty: the quality of any action may depend on future events that never materialize, on moves that violate game rules, or on decisions made by other players. Standard reinforcement learning assumes that rewards can be assigned at each step, but this assumption fails in settings where outcomes are entangled across time and agents. We introduce delayed per-step reward attribution with eligibility gating, an episode lifecycle and postprocessing pipeline that computes rewards only at episode end, propagates them back to originating steps according to task-specific semantics, and excludes steps that lack valid dependent information from training. Together with asynchronous rollout generation via vLLM's continuous batching, curriculum-based opponent sampling, and multi-level stratified batch construction, this approach enables stable, sample-efficient RL training in multi-agent environments. We evaluate on the MindGames Arena benchmark at NeurIPS 2025, where a single 8-billion-parameter open-source model trained with our method matched or surpassed substantially larger proprietary systems, including GPT-5, in head-to-head play and took first place in both the Open (unrestricted) and Efficient (<=8B parameters) tracks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对多智能体战略交互场景的强化学习训练方法，通过延迟逐步奖励归因与资格门控、异步rollout生成、课程式对手采样和多层分层批次构建，使80亿参数的开源模型在MindGames Arena基准上击败了包括GPT-5在内的大型专有系统，在开放和高效两个赛道均获第一。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体战略交互中，标准强化学习假设每一步都能分配奖励，但实际场景中行动质量取决于未来未发生的事件、违反规则的动作或其他玩家的决策，奖励在时间和智能体间高度耦合，导致训练困难。
AI.method: 1) 延迟逐步奖励归因与资格门控：仅在回合结束时计算总奖励，根据任务语义回溯分配到原始步骤，排除缺乏有效依赖信息的步骤；2) 异步rollout生成：利用vLLM的持续批处理；3) 课程式对手采样；4) 多层分层批次构建。
AI.result: 在NeurIPS 2025 MindGames Arena基准测试中，单个80亿参数开源模型在正面交锋中匹配或超越包括GPT-5在内的更大规模专有系统，在开放赛道和高效赛道(<=8B参数)均获第一名。
AI.conclusion: 延迟逐步奖励归因与资格门控结合异步rollout、课程式对手采样和分层批次构建，能够实现多智能体环境中稳定、样本高效的RL训练，小模型也能超越大型专有系统。
idea_en: Delayed per-step reward attribution with eligibility gating: a method that computes total episode reward only at episode end, then propagates rewards back to originating steps based on task-specific semantics while excluding steps lacking valid dependent information from training.

Episode lifecycle and postprocessing pipeline for multi-agent RL: a novel pipeline architecture that defers reward computation to episode termination and performs semantic-aware backward reward propagation.

Eligibility gating mechanism for step exclusion: a technique to identify and exclude training steps that lack valid dependent information (e.g., due to future events never materializing, rule violations, or other agents' decisions), preventing noise in RL training.
Asynchronous rollout generation using vLLM continuous batching for multi-agent RL training: leveraging continuous batching to efficiently generate asynchronous rollouts in multi-agent environments.
Curriculum-based opponent sampling for multi-agent RL: dynamically sampling opponents of varying difficulty levels during training to improve policy robustness.
Multi-level stratified batch construction: a batch construction method that ensures diverse and representative training samples across multiple stratification levels.
idea_ch: 延迟逐步奖励归因与资格门控方法：仅在回合结束时计算总奖励，根据任务语义将奖励回溯分配到原始步骤，并排除缺乏有效依赖信息的步骤不参与训练。
回合生命周期与后处理流水线：一种新颖的流水线架构，将奖励计算推迟到回合终止，并执行语义感知的向后奖励传播。
资格门控步骤排除机制：识别并排除那些因未来事件未发生、规则违反或其他智能体决策而缺乏有效依赖信息的训练步骤，防止RL训练中的噪声。
基于vLLM连续批处理的异步rollout生成：利用连续批处理技术在多智能体环境中高效生成异步rollout数据。
课程式对手采样策略：在训练过程中动态采样不同难度的对手，提升策略的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
多层分层批次构建方法：在多个分层级别上确保训练样本的多样性和代表性，提升训练稳定性。

title: Universal Quantum Transformer
summary: Classical continuous-space neural networks fundamentally struggle to lock into exact mathematical symmetries, such as modular arithmetic and non-commutative algebra. To approximate these discrete logical rules, they often rely on massive parameter scaling, resulting in stochastic instability even after delayed generalization phenomena known as grokking. Here, we introduce the Universal Quantum Transformer (UQT), a fundamentally novel, quantum-native computing architecture that uses the physical properties of multi-qubit systems as a universal inductive bias for exact mathematical and algebraic reasoning. Rather than translating classical neural mechanisms, our framework relies entirely on parameterized geometric phase embedding and $SU(2)$ wave-interference. We demonstrate that the quantum attention circuit, operating on a highly compact 5-qubit substrate, perfectly learns two highly distinct formal classes: cyclic modular arithmetic ($\mathbb{Z}_{11}$) and non-Abelian algebra (the $S_4$ permutation group). While classical attention-based networks exhibit stochastic instability at convergence, the UQT achieves mathematically exact, deterministic generalization. We refer to this phenomenon as crystallization: a step beyond the well-known phenomenon of grokking. Crucially, this framework yields massive computational and memory advantages by theoretically bypassing the quadratic bottleneck of classical self-attention, and by logarithmically compressing the required representation dimension to eliminate the massive over-parameterization inherent to classical networks. Finally, we deploy this architecture on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware, proving its viability on current IBM Quantum computers. These results establish parameterized quantum topology as a universally superior physical substrate for exact artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用量子变压器(UQT)，一种利用多量子比特系统物理属性进行精确数学和代数推理的量子原生计算架构，在5量子比特上完美学习循环模算术和非阿贝尔代数，实现了超越经典网络的“结晶化”现象。
AI.motivation: 经典连续空间神经网络难以锁定精确数学对称性（如模算术、非交换代数），依赖大规模参数近似导致随机不稳定性，需解决精确数学推理的固有限制。
AI.method: 提出UQT架构，核心依赖参数化几何相位嵌入和SU(2)波干涉，而非翻译经典神经机制；量子注意力电路运行在紧凑5量子比特衬底上。
AI.result: UQT在5量子比特上完美学习Z_11模算术和S_4置换群；实现数学精确、确定性的泛化（结晶化）；理论绕过经典自注意力的二次瓶颈，对数压缩表示维度；在IBM量子计算机上验证了NISQ可行性。
AI.conclusion: 参数化量子拓扑作为精确人工智能的通用优越物理衬底，实现了超越经典网络groking现象的确定性泛化。
idea_en: Universal Quantum Transformer (UQT) architecture using parameterized geometric phase embedding and SU(2) wave-interference for exact mathematical reasoning
Quantum attention circuit operating on compact qubit substrates that achieves mathematically exact deterministic generalization (crystallization)
Logarithmic compression of representation dimension eliminating massive over-parameterization in classical networks for algebraic reasoning
Parameterized quantum topology as physical substrate for exact AI bypassing quadratic bottleneck of classical self-attention
NISQ-deployable quantum computing architecture for exact modular arithmetic and non-Abelian algebra learning
idea_ch: 通用量子变压器(UQT)架构：利用参数化几何相位嵌入和SU(2)波干涉进行精确数学推理
紧凑量子比特衬底上的量子注意力电路：实现数学精确、确定性泛化的'结晶化'现象
表示维度的对数压缩机制：消除经典网络在代数推理中的大规模过参数化
参数化量子拓扑作为精确人工智能物理衬底：理论绕过经典自注意力的二次瓶颈
可在NISQ设备部署的量子计算架构：实现精确模算术和非阿贝尔代数学习

title: Grokers: Bottom-Up Inductive Comprehension and Write-Time Intelligence over Typed Knowledge Graphs
comment: 6 pages; second in a series with the Magarshak Machine / SPACER paper and the Context paper
summary: We present Grokers, an architecture for building persistent, structured comprehension of typed knowledge graphs through bottom-up inductive traversal of dependency subgraphs. Unlike retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which pays full comprehension cost at every query, Grokers pushes intelligence to write time: autonomous Groker agents analyze nodes in a typed stream graph, extract structured attributes via governed language model (LM) calls, and inductively compose that understanding upward through dependency relations, writing enriched typed attributes that serve all future queries at zero additional LM cost. We prove three formal properties: (1) the Byte-Identity Theorem, establishing that context blocks assembled from a transactionally-maintained denormalization index are byte-identical across LM turns between semantic changes, enabling KV-cache hit rates approaching 100%; (2) the Accumulation Monotonicity Theorem, establishing that the fraction of interactions resolved without LM calls is non-decreasing in the number of completed interactions under a governed wisdom library growth protocol; and (3) the Dual-Traversal Ordering Theorem, establishing that top-down generation and bottom-up comprehension are the unique correct traversal orderings for their respective tasks over a dependency DAG, and that their composition closes into a complete generation-comprehension cycle. We further present a deterministic alternative to embedding-based semantic search, with a synonym caching protocol whose LM fallback rate converges to zero for finite-vocabulary domains. A reference implementation is provided in the open-source Qbix / Safebox / Safebots stack.

AI.tldr: Grokers是一种通过自底向上归纳遍历依赖子图来构建持久化、结构化类型知识图谱理解的架构，相较于RAG在每次查询时都消耗全部理解成本，Grokers将智能推向写入阶段，通过自主Groker代理在写入时分析节点、提取结构化属性，使得后续查询几乎零额外LM成本。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG方法每次查询都需要重新进行理解推理，计算成本随查询量线性增长。论文旨在构建一种写入即理解的知识图谱架构，使得理解工作在数据写入时一次性完成，后续查询几乎无需额外大模型调用成本。
AI.method: 提出Grokers架构：由自主Groker代理在写入阶段自底向上遍历依赖子图，通过受控大模型调用提取结构化属性，并归纳式向上组合理解，写入富化类型化属性。同时提出基于事务维护的反规范化索引以实现字节一致上下文、同义词缓存协议替代嵌入向量语义搜索等机制。
AI.result: 证明了三个形式化定理：字节恒等定理（上下文块在语义变化间字节一致，KV缓存命中率接近100%）、累积单调性定理（无需LM调用解决交互的比例随已完成交互数单调不减）、双遍历顺序定理（自顶向下生成和自底向上理解是各自任务的唯一正确遍历顺序）。同义词缓存协议的LM回退率在有限词汇域趋近于零。
AI.conclusion: Grokers架构证明了一种新的知识图谱理解范式：将理解成本从查询时转移到写入时，通过形式化保证实现了接近零额外LM成本的查询，为知识密集型应用提供了一种高效、可验证的替代方案。
idea_en: A system for persistent structured comprehension of typed knowledge graphs via bottom-up inductive traversal of dependency subgraphs by autonomous agents during data write time, enabling zero additional LM inference cost at query time.

A transactionally-maintained denormalization index that ensures byte-identical context blocks across LM turns between semantic changes, enabling KV-cache hit rates approaching 100% for repeated queries.
A synonym caching protocol that serves as a deterministic alternative to embedding-based semantic search, with LM fallback rate converging to zero for finite-vocabulary domains.
A governed wisdom library growth protocol that ensures the fraction of interactions resolved without LM calls is monotonically non-decreasing over completed interactions.

A dual-traversal ordering method establishing top-down generation and bottom-up comprehension as the unique correct traversal orderings for their respective tasks over a dependency DAG, forming a complete generation-comprehension cycle.
Autonomous Groker agents that analyze nodes in a typed stream graph, extract structured attributes via governed LM calls, and inductively compose understanding upward through dependency relations.
idea_ch: 一种通过自底向上归纳遍历依赖子图来构建持久化结构化类型知识图谱理解的系统，由自主代理在数据写入时执行理解工作，使查询时无需额外大模型推理成本。
一种基于事务维护的反规范化索引，确保在语义变化之间的大模型调用轮次中上下文块字节一致，使重复查询的KV缓存命中率接近100%。
一种同义词缓存协议，作为基于嵌入向量语义搜索的确定性替代方案，在有限词汇域中其大模型回退率趋近于零。
一种受控智慧库增长协议，确保无需大模型调用即可解决的交互比例随已完成交互数量单调不减。
一种双遍历排序方法，确立自顶向下生成和自底向上理解为依赖DAG上各自任务的唯一正确遍历顺序，形成完整的生成-理解闭环。
自主Groker代理，能够分析类型化流图中的节点，通过受控大模型调用提取结构化属性，并通过依赖关系向上归纳式组合理解。

title: Product-Aware Deep Autoencoders for Robust Process Monitoring in Multi-Product Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: As Industry 4.0 accelerates the integration of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) in manufacturing, robust anomaly detection has become critical for ensuring process safety and security. Current data-driven approaches typically employ "product-agnostic" or global models trained on the aggregate of all normal operating data. However, modern industrial facilities frequently operate under diverse product grades. While computationally simple, these global models inherently expand their decision boundaries to accommodate the variance of multiple modes, creating a "blind spot" where subtle anomalies or targeted cyber-physical attacks may be masked by the wide acceptance region of the model. In this work, we first demonstrate that the vulnerability described above is present in global-agnostic models operating across multiple product grades. We then present a Product-Aware Autoencoder as a principled mitigation that restricts the learning domain to grade-specific distributions. While this approach reduces the identified blind-spot risk, we do not claim it as the optimal mitigation among all possible alternatives. We rigorously validate this approach against a Global Agnostic baseline using the Extended Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) benchmark. Our empirical results indicate that the Product-Aware framework performs comparably to the global baseline on standard detection metrics, while offering improved robustness to product-grade-specific operating modes. Most critically, stress tests simulating our hypothetical attack scenarios reveal that while the global model fails to detect operational deviations in 77.8% of the scenarios, the product-aware system achieves 100% detection accuracy. These findings suggest that, in flexible manufacturing environments, generalized anomaly detectors can pose non-trivial security risks, motivating a shift toward mode-aware diagnostic architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文指出在多产品等级柔性制造环境中，传统的"产品无关"全局异常检测模型存在盲区风险，易被针对特定产品模式的攻击绕过。提出了一种产品感知自编码器方法，通过限制学习域到特定产品等级分布来缓解该风险。在扩展TEP基准测试中，该方法在标准检测指标上与全局基线相当，但在压力测试中检测率从全局模型的22.2%提升至100%。
AI.motivation: 当前工业异常检测普遍采用"产品无关"全局模型，但柔性制造中多产品等级会导致模型决策边界扩大，产生盲区，使细微异常或网络物理攻击可能被掩盖。需验证该漏洞并探索面向产品模式的缓解方案。
AI.method: 提出Product-Aware Autoencoder（产品感知自编码器），为每个产品等级分别训练独立的自编码器模型，将学习域限制在特定等级的数据分布内，而非使用全局统一模型。
AI.result: 在扩展TEP基准测试中：1）标准检测指标上产品感知方法与全局基线性能相当；2）压力测试中全局模型在77.8%场景下未能检测到操作偏差，而产品感知系统达到100%检测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 柔性制造环境中，通用异常检测器存在重大安全风险，应转向模式感知的诊断架构。产品感知自编码器是一种有效的缓解方案，但不一定是最优方案。
idea_en: A product-aware anomaly detection method for Cyber-Physical Systems in manufacturing, where separate autoencoder models are trained per product grade to restrict learning domain to grade-specific data distributions
A stress testing methodology to evaluate blind-spot vulnerabilities in global-agnostic anomaly detectors under multi-product-grade operating scenarios
A security risk assessment framework revealing that global anomaly detectors fail in 77.8% of attack scenarios in flexible manufacturing environments
A product-mode-aware diagnostic architecture that achieves 100% detection accuracy for operational deviations across different product grades
idea_ch: 一种面向制造信息物理系统的产品感知异常检测方法，为每个产品等级独立训练自编码器模型，将学习域限制在特定等级数据分布内
一种评估全局无关异常检测器在多产品等级运行场景下盲区漏洞的压力测试方法
一种安全风险评估框架，揭示柔性制造环境中全局异常检测器在77.8%的攻击场景下失效
一种产品模式感知的诊断架构，在不同产品等级间实现对操作偏差的100%检测准确率

title: On the evolution of the concept of probability as a mirror of the evolution of reason
summary: Over the centuries, probability theory has grown from the calculus of games of chance into a central framework for reasoning under uncertainty. This article interprets that evolution not merely as a mathematical history, but as a transformation of rationality itself. From Pascal and Fermat's combinatorial symmetry to the inductive logic of Bayes and Laplace, from Poisson's statistics of events to Kolmogorov's axiomatic formalization, probability progressively incorporated uncertainty, time, and coherence into scientific judgment. This trajectory reaches a mature epistemological form in modern Bayesian inference, especially in Tarantola's view of probability as a logic of information, where prior knowledge and data are combined coherently. Yet this framework also exposes a limit: probability quantifies uncertainty about well-defined propositions, but does not by itself formalize the vagueness of the concepts used to describe them. The article therefore examines how rationality extends beyond probability. Fuzzy logic is presented as a rigorous language for graded meaning and qualitative judgment, while deep learning is analyzed as a distinct, powerful mode of prediction based on geometric interpolation and optimization rather than explicit inference. By situating probability, fuzzy logic, and deep learning in a common historical and epistemological perspective, the article clarifies their roles and limits. It argues that contemporary scientific rationality cannot be reduced to data-driven performance alone, but requires the explicit articulation of uncertainty, vagueness, and inference.

AI.tldr: 本文从认识论角度追溯概率论从博弈计算到不确定性推理框架的演变历程，并探讨其与模糊逻辑、深度学习的关系与边界，认为现代科学理性需要明确表达不确定性、模糊性和推理过程。
AI.motivation: 作者试图超越纯数学史视角，从理性形式的演化角度理解概率论的发展，并揭示概率框架在概念模糊性方面的局限，进而探索理性在概率之外如何延伸。
AI.method: 通过历史认识论分析，梳理概率论从帕斯卡/费马、贝叶斯/拉普拉斯、泊松到柯尔莫哥洛夫、现代贝叶斯推理（Tarantola）的发展路径，并将其与模糊逻辑、深度学习进行比较分析。
AI.result: 概率论能够良好处理明确命题的不确定性，但无法形式化描述概念本身的模糊性；模糊逻辑提供了分级语义和定性判断的语言，深度学习则提供基于几何插值和优化的预测模式。
AI.conclusion: 当代科学理性不能仅还原为数据驱动的性能，而需要明确阐述不确定性、模糊性和推理三者的关系。
idea_en: A hybrid inference framework that combines Bayesian probability for well-defined propositions with fuzzy logic for graded meaning and qualitative judgment
A method for formalizing vagueness in scientific concepts by integrating fuzzy logic with probabilistic uncertainty quantification
A system architecture that layers deep learning geometric interpolation on top of probabilistic inference to handle both explicit uncertainty and implicit concept vagueness
An epistemological coherence metric that evaluates rationality across probabilistic, fuzzy, and deep learning reasoning modes
idea_ch: 一种混合推理框架，将贝叶斯概率（用于明确定义的命题）与模糊逻辑（用于分级语义和定性判断）相结合
一种通过集成模糊逻辑与概率不确定性量化来形式化科学概念模糊性的方法
一种将深度学习几何插值层叠在概率推理之上的系统架构，以同时处理显式不确定性和隐式概念模糊性
一种跨概率、模糊逻辑和深度学习推理模式来评估理性的认识论一致性度量指标

title: Evaluating Interactive Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Hierarchical Benchmark with Executable Games
summary: We introduce a multi-turn interactive framework for reasoning evaluation that treats reasoning as active evidence acquisition and belief updating. Wherein, LLMs receive only the task rules, must issue targeted queries to a hidden environment, integrate partial observations over time, and decide when to submit a final answer. Beyond standard success rate and interaction efficiency, we evaluate contextual robustness under controlled contextual perturbations, and metacognitive adaptation through counterfactual revision and necessity judgment. We instantiate the framework as a benchmark of 474 executable games, each evaluated under five fixed configuration search spaces corresponding to five difficulty levels, and evaluate a broad set of frontier LLMs. Results show that the benchmark is highly discriminative, exposing large differences not only in success rate but also in interaction efficiency. Moreover, we empirically show that contextual perturbations cause moderate but consistent declines, whereas counterfactual revision and necessity judgment lead to much larger drops.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多轮交互式推理评估框架，将推理视为主动证据获取和信念更新过程。LLM需在隐藏环境中主动查询、整合部分观察结果，并决定何时提交最终答案。构建了包含474个可执行游戏的基准测试，在五个难度级别下评估前沿LLM，发现基准具有高区分度，并揭示了上下文扰动、反事实修正和必要性判断对模型性能的不同影响。
AI.motivation: 现有推理评估方法多基于静态输入输出，未能捕捉真实世界推理所需的主动信息获取、信念更新和元认知适应能力。作者旨在设计一个更贴近实际决策过程的动态交互式推理评估框架。
AI.method: 构建多轮交互框架，LLM接收任务规则后向隐藏环境发起查询，逐步整合部分观察结果，自主决定何时提交答案。基准包含474个可执行游戏，每游戏在五个固定配置搜索空间（对应五个难度级别）下评估。除标准成功率和交互效率外，还评估上下文扰动下的鲁棒性、反事实修正和必要性判断下的元认知适应能力。
AI.result: 基准具有高区分度，能暴露LLM在成功率和交互效率上的显著差异。上下文扰动导致中等但一致的性能下降，而反事实修正和必要性判断导致更大的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 该交互式推理评估框架能更全面地评估LLM的推理能力，揭示了现有模型在主动证据获取、元认知调整等关键维度上的不足，为未来模型改进提供了方向。
idea_en: A multi-turn interactive framework for reasoning evaluation treating reasoning as active evidence acquisition and belief updating, where LLMs issue targeted queries to a hidden environment, integrate partial observations over time, and autonomously decide when to submit a final answer.
A contextual robustness evaluation method under controlled contextual perturbations for LLM reasoning assessment.
A metacognitive adaptation testing approach using counterfactual revision and necessity judgment tasks to evaluate LLM's ability to revise beliefs and assess necessity of information.
A benchmark of 474 executable games with five fixed configuration search spaces corresponding to five difficulty levels for standardized LLM reasoning evaluation.
A method for simultaneously evaluating both success rate and interaction efficiency in multi-turn reasoning tasks, providing a more comprehensive assessment of LLM reasoning capabilities.
idea_ch: 一种多轮交互式推理评估框架，将推理视为主动证据获取和信念更新过程，LLM向隐藏环境发起目标查询、随时间整合部分观察结果，并自主决定何时提交最终答案。
一种在受控上下文扰动下评估LLM推理鲁棒性的方法。
一种元认知适应能力测试方法，通过反事实修正和必要性判断任务评估LLM修正信念和判断信息必要性的能力。
一种包含474个可执行游戏、每个游戏在五个固定配置搜索空间（对应五个难度级别）下评估的标准化LLM推理基准测试。
一种在多轮推理任务中同时评估成功率和交互效率的方法，提供更全面的LLM推理能力评估。

title: A Multi-AI-agent Framework Enabling End-to-end Finite Element Analysis for Solid Mechanics Problems
summary: Finite element analysis (FEA) is the most important numerical approach for solid mechanics. Challenges of FEA include a steep learning curve for entry-level users and potential false simulations due to incorrect definitions of key simulation components, such as boundary conditions, load cases, and solution variables. Years of engineering experience are usually necessary for real-world problem-solving. To address these issues, we present AbaqusAgent, a multi-agent framework grounded in large language models (LLMs) for solid mechanics analyses. AbaqusAgent is developed to facilitate analysis case generation and execution using Abaqus, one of the most widely used FEA packages, by turning users' natural-language instructions into executed FEA analyses and result visualization. AbaqusAgent is composed of six agents, including interpreter, architect, input writer, runner, reviewer, and visualizer agents, encompassing all the essential pre-processing and post-processing steps of standard FEA analyses. A wide variety of 50 solid mechanics problems have been successfully validated, achieving an overall success rate of 86%. Beyond improving the efficiency of FEA for solid mechanics problems and lowering the barrier to computational mechanics education, AbaqusAgent advances the human-simulation interaction paradigm and enables integration with AI-empowered optimization and material characterization workflows. The code is available at https://github.com/LIRAM-LIN/AbaqusAgent

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AbaqusAgent，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，能够将自然语言指令转化为Abaqus有限元分析案例生成、执行和结果可视化，在50个固体力学问题中取得86%的成功率，降低了FEA使用门槛。
AI.motivation: 传统有限元分析软件（如Abaqus）存在学习曲线陡峭、关键参数（边界条件、载荷工况、求解变量等）设置易出错、需要多年工程经验积累等问题，导致入门门槛高且存在仿真错误风险。
AI.method: 构建由六个智能体组成的多智能体框架：解释器（interpreter）、架构师（architect）、输入文件编写器（input writer）、运行器（runner）、审查器（reviewer）和可视化器（visualizer），覆盖FEA前后处理全流程。利用大语言模型将用户自然语言指令解析并转换为可执行的Abaqus分析流程。
AI.result: 在50个不同类型的固体力学问题上进行验证，整体成功率达到86%。
AI.conclusion: AbaqusAgent不仅提高了固体力学FEA的效率、降低了计算力学教育的门槛，还革新了人-仿真交互范式，可与AI驱动的优化及材料表征工作流集成。
idea_en: A multi-agent framework (AbaqusAgent) grounded in LLMs that translates natural language instructions into executable Abaqus FEA analyses, covering pre-processing and post-processing steps.
An interpreter agent that parses user natural language descriptions into structured simulation requirements for solid mechanics problems.
An architect agent that autonomously determines appropriate boundary conditions, load cases, and solution variables for FEA models based on natural language input.
An input writer agent that automatically generates Abaqus input files (.inp) from high-level simulation specifications.
A reviewer agent that validates and verifies the correctness of generated FEA models before execution.
A runner agent that handles the execution of Abaqus simulations and manages solver interactions.
A visualizer agent that automatically generates result visualization from simulation output data.
A closed-loop multi-agent pipeline for FEA that integrates natural language understanding, model generation, execution, verification, and visualization into a unified workflow.
A method for lowering the barrier to entry in computational mechanics by enabling non-expert users to perform FEA through conversational interfaces.
Integration architecture combining LLM-based agents with commercial FEA software (Abaqus) for automated simulation workflow.
idea_ch: 一种基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，将用户的自然语言指令自动转换为可执行的Abaqus有限元分析案例，覆盖预处理和后处理全流程。
解释器智能体：将用户的自然语言描述解析为固体力学问题的结构化仿真需求。
架构师智能体：根据自然语言输入自动确定FEA模型的边界条件、载荷工况和求解变量等关键参数。
输入文件编写器智能体：从高层仿真规格说明自动生成Abaqus输入文件（.inp）。
审查器智能体：在执行前对生成的FEA模型进行正确性验证和确认。
运行器智能体：负责Abaqus仿真的执行执行和求解器交互管理。
可视化器智能体：从仿真输出数据自动生成结果可视化图表。
一种将自然语言理解、模型生成、执行执行、验证和可视化集成到统一工作流的闭环多智能体FEA管线。
一种通过对话式交互界面使非专业用户能够执行有限元分析的方法，降低计算力学的入门门槛。
将基于LLM的智能体与商业FEA软件（Abaqus）集成的架构，实现自动化仿真工作流。

title: CAST: Non-Privileged Clipped Asymmetric Self-Teaching with Advantage Flipping for GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), especially Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has been widely used to improve reasoning in large language models. However, outcome-level rewards provide only sparse supervision, and group-relative advantages vanish when all sampled trajectories for a prompt are either correct or incorrect. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) offers dense token-level guidance, but its token preferences are not necessarily aligned with trajectory correctness; empirical diagnostics show that OPSD signals behave differently on correct and incorrect rollouts, with teacher-positive and teacher-negative gap signals exhibiting different noise profiles. These diagnostics are conducted under an OPSD-style privileged teacher context for analysis only, whereas CAST training uses answer-free self-teacher scoring.Motivated by these observations, this work proposes CAST, an answer-free self-distillation method for GRPO-style RLVR. CAST keeps the verifier-grounded GRPO objective, but uses a stop-gradient self-teacher to shape token-level advantages according to trajectory correctness. Unlike prior self-distilled RLVR methods, CAST does not require reference-solution-conditioned teacher scoring, keeps the self-teacher log-probability gap active throughout training, and applies bidirectional local advantage sign reversal: teacher-negative tokens in correct trajectories can receive negative token-level advantages, while teacher-positive tokens in incorrect trajectories can receive bounded positive local advantages. For zero-variance all-correct and all-wrong groups, CAST assigns bounded sign-constrained base advantages, so these otherwise zero-gradient groups can contribute verifier-signed token feedback. Experiments on mathematical reasoning show that CAST improves RLVR training while retaining a lightweight, verifier-grounded trajectory-level objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAST方法，一种无需参考答案的自我蒸馏技术，用于改进GRPO风格的强化学习训练。CAST通过stop-gradient自教师模型根据轨迹正确性塑造token级优势，解决了GRPO中全对/全错组梯度消失和OPSD信号噪声问题，在数学推理任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法存在两个关键问题：(1) GRPO的outcome级奖励提供稀疏监督，且当所有轨迹全对或全错时group-relative优势消失；(2) OPSD提供密集token级引导，但其token偏好与轨迹正确性不一致，且教师正/负信号存在不同噪声分布。因此需要一种既能提供密集监督又保持与轨迹正确性对齐的方法。
AI.method: CAST方法：(1) 保留verifier-grounded GRPO目标函数；(2) 使用stop-gradient自教师模型，通过log-probability gap信号塑造token级优势；(3) 双向局部优势符号反转：正确轨迹中的教师负token获得负优势，错误轨迹中的教师正token获得有界正优势；(4) 对于全对/全错零方差组，分配有界符号约束的基础优势，使梯度不消失。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上的实验表明，CAST方法相比标准GRPO和其他baseline提升了RLVR训练效果，同时保持了轻量级、verifier-grounded的轨迹级目标。
AI.conclusion: CAST通过自教师蒸馏和双向优势符号反转，有效解决了GRPO的稀疏监督和零梯度问题，为token级奖励信号与轨迹正确性对齐提供了新思路。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning training method that uses a stop-gradient self-teacher model to compute token-level advantage signals based on log-probability gap between current policy and self-teacher, without requiring reference solutions.

A bidirectional local advantage sign reversal mechanism that assigns negative token-level advantages to teacher-negative tokens in correct trajectories and bounded positive local advantages to teacher-positive tokens in incorrect trajectories.

A bounded sign-constrained base advantage assignment method for zero-variance groups (all-correct or all-wrong trajectories), enabling otherwise zero-gradient groups to contribute verifier-signed token feedback.
A self-distillation training framework that keeps the self-teacher log-probability gap active throughout the entire training process, unlike prior methods that anneal or stop the teacher signal.
idea_ch: 一种使用stop-gradient自教师模型的强化学习训练方法，基于当前策略与自教师之间的对数概率差值（log-probability gap）计算token级优势信号，无需参考答案条件化教师评分。
一种双向局部优势符号反转机制：对正确轨迹中教师负向token分配负的token级优势，对错误轨迹中教师正向token分配有界正局部优势，实现token级奖励与轨迹正确性对齐。
一种针对零方差组（全对或全错轨迹）的有界符号约束基础优势分配方法，使原本零梯度的组能够贡献经过验证器签名的token级反馈信号。
一种自蒸馏训练框架，在整个训练过程中保持自教师log-probability gap持续激活，克服了先前方法中教师信号逐渐衰减或停止的问题。

title: TIGER: Traceable Inference with Graph-Based Evidence Routing for Mitigating Hallucinations in Multimodal Generation
summary: We study fact-level repair for multimodal generation, where a fluent output may contain specific facts that are not supported by the input. Existing inference-time repair methods often generate feedback by jointly conditioning on the input and the current output. This design has two limitations: hallucinated claims in the output can bias the model's interpretation of the input, and free-form feedback cannot be ranked or scheduled at the fact level. We present TIGER, an inference-time framework that redesigns feedback for localized repair. TIGER independently extracts an observation graph from the input and a claim graph from the current output, then assigns each claim a graph-conditioned risk score based on support and conflict. The model repairs selected high-risk claims while keeping the backbone frozen. We provide a convergence analysis showing that the expected total risk decreases geometrically to an explicit asymptotic bound under mild assumptions. Experiments across four cross-modal paths, including image-to-text, image+text-to-text, audio-to-text, and video-to-text, show that TIGER reduces unsupported content while preserving task quality. The gains hold across multiple backbones, and a CrisisFACTS case study suggests that the same repair mechanism can improve grounding in multi-source settings.

AI.tldr: TIGER是一个推理时框架，通过独立提取输入观察图和输出声明图，对每个声明进行图条件风险评分，实现多模态生成中事实级别的精准修复。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时修复方法存在两个局限：1) 输出中的幻觉会偏置模型对输入的理解；2) 自由形式反馈无法在事实层面进行排序和调度。
AI.method: TIGER从输入中独立提取观察图，从当前输出中提取声明图，为每个声明分配基于图条件的风险分数（支持/冲突），然后选择高风险声明进行修复，同时保持模型主干冻结。
AI.result: 在图像到文本、图像+文本到文本、音频到文本、视频到文本四种跨模态路径上，TIGER均减少了不支持的生成内容，同时保持了任务质量，且在不同主干模型上表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: TIGER提供了一种可收敛的、事实级别的多模态生成修复方法，能够在多来源场景中提升接地性。
idea_en: Independent observation graph and claim graph extraction mechanism for isolating hallucination bias in multimodal generation
Graph-conditioned risk scoring system for ranking individual factual claims based on support and conflict metrics
Frozen-backbone localized repair method that selectively repairs high-risk claims without retraining
Convergent inference-time repair framework with geometric risk reduction to explicit asymptotic bound
idea_ch: 独立提取输入观察图和输出声明图的双图机制，消除输出幻觉对输入理解的偏置影响
基于图条件的风险评分系统，通过支持度和冲突度对每个事实声明进行量化和排序
冻结主干模型的局部修复方法，仅对高风险声明进行选择性修复，无需重新训练
具有几何级风险收敛到明确渐近边界的推理时修复框架，保证修复过程的收敛性

title: MindZero: Learning Online Mental Reasoning With Zero Annotations
summary: Effective real-world assistance requires AI agents with robust Theory of Mind (ToM): inferring human mental states from their behavior. Despite recent advances, several key challenges remain, including (1) online inference with robust uncertainty updates over multiple hypotheses; (2) efficient reasoning suitable for real-time assistance; and (3) the lack of ground-truth mental state annotations in real-world domains. We address these challenges by introducing MindZero, a self-supervised reinforcement learning framework that trains multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for efficient and robust online mental reasoning. During training, the model is rewarded for generating mental state hypotheses that maximize the likelihood of observed actions estimated by a planner, similar to model-based ToM reasoning. This method thus eliminates the need for explicit mental state annotations. After training, MindZero internalizes model-based reasoning into fast single-pass inference. We evaluate MindZero against baselines across challenging mental reasoning and AI assistance tasks in gridworld and household domains. We found that LLMs alone are insufficient; model-based methods improve accuracy but are slow, costly, and limited by backbone MLLM capacity. In contrast, MindZero enhances MLLMs' intrinsic ToM ability and significantly outperforms model-based methods in both accuracy and efficiency, showing that mental reasoning can be effectively learned as a self-supervised skill.

AI.tldr: MindZero是一个自监督强化学习框架，训练多模态大语言模型进行高效、鲁棒的在线心理推理，无需显式心理状态标注，在准确性和效率上均优于基于模型的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理在现实世界辅助中面临三个关键挑战：(1)在线推理中对多个假设进行鲁棒的不确定性更新；(2)适合实时辅助的高效推理；(3)真实域中缺乏心理状态标注真值。
AI.method: MindZero采用自监督强化学习框架，训练多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)。训练时，模型生成的心理状态假设通过规划器评估其对观察动作的预测似然性作为奖励信号，类似于基于模型的ToM推理，无需显式标注。训练后将基于模型的推理内化为快速单次前向推理。
AI.result: 在gridworld和 household域的挑战性心理推理和AI辅助任务上，MindZero显著优于LLM基线，在准确性和效率上均超过基于模型的方法。
AI.conclusion: 心理推理可以作为一种自监督技能被有效学习，MindZero增强了MLLM的内在ToM能力。
idea_en: A self-supervised reinforcement learning method for training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform online Theory of Mind reasoning without ground-truth mental state annotations
A reward mechanism based on a planner's evaluation of action likelihood to guide mental state hypothesis generation, eliminating the need for explicit mental state labels
A framework that internalizes model-based Theory of Mind reasoning into fast single-pass inference during training, enabling real-time mental reasoning
A system that uses a planner to assess how well generated mental state hypotheses predict observed actions, serving as training signal for self-supervised learning
idea_ch: 一种自监督强化学习方法，用于训练多模态大语言模型执行在线心理推理，无需真实心理状态标注
一种基于规划器对动作似然性评估的奖励机制，用于引导心理状态假设生成，消除对显式心理状态标签的需求
一种将基于模型的心理推理内化为快速单次前向推理的框架，实现实时心理推理能力
一种使用规划器评估生成的心理状态假设对观察动作的预测能力，作为自监督学习训练信号的系统

title: Geodesic Flow Matching for Denoising High-Dimensional Structured Representations
summary: Vector Symbolic Algebras (VSAs) enable robust neurosymbolic reasoning by encoding symbolic information into high-dimensional distributed representations. For continuous domains, Spatial Semantic Pointers (SSPs) extend this framework by mapping variables onto continuous toroidal manifolds. However, standard approaches like Flow Matching assume a flat Euclidean geometry, which fails to account for the geometric constraints imposed on valid SSP states. We demonstrate that this assumption fails for SSPs: Euclidean linear interpolants ``cut through" the manifold's interior, destroying the phase and magnitude structure required for accurate decoding. To resolve this, we employ Geodesic Flow Matching, adapting Riemannian transport dynamics to strictly restrict the denoising flow to the SSP toroidal manifold. We validate this approach in a Spiking Neural SLAM system, showing that manifold-aware cleanup stabilizes path integration against drift. The method achieves a 72\% reduction in tracking error and enables a 40\% increase in neural efficiency compared to competitive baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/kremHabashy/CleanupSSP .

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于测地线流匹配的SSP清洁方法，解决了标准流匹配假设欧几里得几何导致SSP流形结构破坏的问题，在脉冲神经SLAM系统中实现72%跟踪误差降低和40%神经效率提升。
AI.motivation: 标准流匹配方法假设平坦欧几里得几何，导致SSP的相位和幅度结构被破坏，无法准确解码；需要一种流形感知的清洁方法以保持SSP的拓扑约束。
AI.method: 采用测地线流匹配（Geodesic Flow Matching），将去噪流严格限制在SSP环形流形上，利用黎曼传输动力学替代欧几里得线性插值。
AI.result: 跟踪误差降低72%，神经效率提升40%，在脉冲神经SLAM系统中验证了路径积分稳定性的提升。
AI.conclusion: 流形感知的清洁方法能有效保持SSP结构完整性，显著提升神经符号系统的鲁棒性和效率。
idea_en: A method for cleaning Spatial Semantic Pointers (SSPs) using Geodesic Flow Matching that restricts denoising flow to the toroidal manifold of SSPs, preventing distortion of phase and magnitude structure.
A Riemannian transport dynamics approach for SSP cleanup that replaces Euclidean linear interpolation with manifold-aware geodesic interpolation in high-dimensional distributed representations.
A Spiking Neural SLAM system enhanced with manifold-aware SSP cleanup that stabilizes path integration against drift, achieving 72% reduction in tracking error.
A neural efficiency optimization technique that achieves 40% improvement by leveraging geometric constraints of SSP manifolds during the cleanup process.
idea_ch: 一种基于测地线流匹配的空间语义指针清洁方法，将去噪流严格限制在SSP环形流形上，防止相位和幅度结构失真
一种用于SSP清洁的黎曼传输动力学方法，用流形感知的测地线插值替代欧几里得线性插值
一种增强型脉冲神经SLAM系统，采用流形感知的SSP清洁机制稳定路径积分，实现72%跟踪误差降低
一种利用SSP流形几何约束实现40%神经效率提升的优化技术

title: Capability Self-Assessment: Teaching LLMs to Know Their Limits
summary: The ability to recognize one's own limitations and decide whether to solve a problem or delegate is fundamental for reliable intelligent systems. Yet we show that modern large language models systematically lack this ability: across diverse model families and scales, they overestimate their competence and attempt queries they cannot solve. We refer to this ability as Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) and formulate it as a policy-learning problem, aiming to improve self-assessment while preserving the model's original capabilities. Our results show that reinforcement learning teaches CSA effectively, significantly outperforming supervised fine-tuning while preserving original capabilities. In contrast, supervised fine-tuning severely degrades the capabilities the model is meant to assess. Moreover, learned self-assessment behavior generalizes well out of distribution, suggesting that CSA is a transferable model trait. Finally, CSA is practically useful: it improves local-cloud decision making at inference time and provides a signal for targeted data selection during training.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型普遍缺乏能力自我评估（CSA）能力，即无法正确判断自身局限并决定是否解决或委派问题。作者将CSA建模为策略学习问题，证明强化学习能有效提升CSA，且优于监督微调，同时保持模型原有能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型缺乏识别自身局限性的能力，倾向于高估自身能力并尝试无法解决的问题，这制约了智能系统的可靠性。
AI.method: 将能力自我评估（CSA）建模为策略学习问题，采用强化学习（RL）进行训练，并与监督微调（SFT）进行对比。
AI.result: 强化学习能有效教会CSA，显著优于监督微调；监督微调会严重退化模型原有能力；学习的CSA行为具有良好的分布外泛化性。
AI.conclusion: CSA是一种可迁移的模型特质，具有实际应用价值：可在推理阶段改进本地-云端决策，并能为训练中的数据选择提供信号。
idea_en: A capability self-assessment (CSA) mechanism for LLMs formulated as a policy-learning problem using reinforcement learning, enabling models to evaluate whether they can solve a query or should delegate.
A reinforcement learning-based training method for improving LLM self-assessment that preserves original model capabilities, unlike supervised fine-tuning which degrades them.
A transferable CSA trait learned via RL that generalizes out-of-distribution across different problem domains.
An inference-time local-cloud decision-making system for LLMs that uses learned self-assessment signals to determine whether to process locally or delegate to cloud resources.
A data selection method for LLM training that leverages self-assessment signals to identify and prioritize beneficial training samples.
idea_ch: 一种基于强化学习的LLM能力自我评估（CSA）策略学习方法，使模型能够自主判断是否能够解决问题或需要委派给其他系统。
一种保留模型原始能力的强化学习训练方法，用于提升LLM的自我评估能力，解决了监督微调导致能力退化的问题。
一种可跨领域迁移的CSA特质学习机制，通过强化学习训练使自我评估行为具有良好的分布外泛化能力。
一种基于自我评估信号的推理时本地-云端决策系统，LLM可根据自评结果决定本地处理还是委派至云端资源。
一种利用自我评估信号进行训练数据选择的方法，通过识别模型难以处理的数据样本优化训练效率。

title: Closed-Loop Neural Activation Control in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF CVPR 2026 Workshop on Visual Concepts (VisCon). 25 pages, 8 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can be steered at test time by intervening on semantically meaningful internal directions, but existing methods use a fixed steering coefficient, effectively operating in open loop. This is poorly suited to embodied control, where task state and concept error evolve over time, often causing overcorrection, oscillation, and reduced task success, especially for temporal behaviors such as speed and smoothness. We propose CTRL-STEER, a closed-loop framework that replaces static intervention strength with adaptive, time-varying control signals. The key idea is to decouple representation from regulation: rather than assuming temporal concepts are directly controlled by individual neurons, we steer along motion-aligned residual directions while a feedback controller adjusts intervention magnitude online. We instantiate this framework with both PID and reinforcement learning based controllers. Experiments with a fine-tuned OpenVLA policy on four LIBERO task suites show that CTRL-STEER achieves more stable concept regulation and a better steering-task success trade-off than fixed-coefficient baselines, without modifying or retraining the base model.

AI.tldr: CTRL-STEER提出了一种闭环框架，用自适应时变控制信号替代固定的干预强度，实现更稳定的视觉-语言-动作模型概念调控。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型的测试时概念干预使用固定系数（开环），不适用于具身控制任务，容易导致过校正、振荡和任务成功率下降，尤其影响速度和平滑度等时序行为。
AI.method: 将表示与调节解耦：沿运动对齐的残差方向进行引导，同时用反馈控制器（PID或强化学习控制器）在线调整干预幅度，实现闭环自适应控制。
AI.result: 在微调OpenVLA策略的四个LIBERO任务套件上，CTRL-STEER相比固定系数基线实现了更稳定的概念调控和更好的引导-任务成功权衡。
AI.conclusion: 闭环自适应控制策略可以显著提升VLA模型在具身控制任务中的稳定性和有效性，且无需修改或重新训练基础模型。
idea_en: A closed-loop steering framework for VLA models that adaptively adjusts intervention strength in real-time using feedback controllers (PID or RL-based), decoupling representation from regulation.
Motion-aligned residual steering directions that replace neuron-level concept control for more stable temporal behavior regulation in embodied control tasks.
A method for online adjustment of steering magnitude via PID controller that responds to evolving task state and concept error during robot task execution.
RL-based controller for adaptive concept intervention in VLA models that learns optimal steering coefficient adjustment policy through interaction.
Decoupled representation-regulation architecture for vision-language-action models where control signals are applied along motion-aligned residual directions rather than individual neuron directions.
idea_ch: 一种用于VLA模型的闭环引导框架，利用反馈控制器（PID或基于强化学习的控制器）实时自适应调整干预强度，将表示与调节解耦。
运动对齐的残差引导方向，替代基于单个神经元的时序概念控制方法，实现更稳定的具身控制任务时序行为调节。
通过PID控制器在线调整引导幅度的方法，在机器人任务执行过程中响应不断变化的任务状态和概念误差。
基于强化学习的自适应概念干预控制器，通过学习策略优化VLA模型中的引导系数动态调整。
视觉-语言-动作模型中表示-调节解耦的架构，控制信号沿运动对齐的残差方向而非单个神经元方向施加。

title: Robust Shielding for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Shielding is an effective approach to formally guarantee the safety of reinforcement learning agents in Markov decision processes (MDPs). However, existing shielding techniques typically assume knowledge of the safety-relevant transition dynamics - a requirement that is seldom met in practice. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel shielding framework for robust MDPs (RMDPs), i.e., MDPs with sets of transition probabilities. We define safety as the satisfaction of a linear temporal logic (LTL) formula with a certain threshold probability under the worst-case transition probabilities of the RMDP. We prove that our shielding framework is both sound and optimal for the RMDP: every policy admissible by the shield is safe, and conversely, every safe RMDP policy is admissible by the shield. We combine our approach with existing sampling methods for learning transition probabilities of MDPs with probably approximately correct (PAC) guarantees. This combination enables the construction of shields for MDPs that, with high confidence, guarantee safety while remaining minimally restrictive. Our experiments show that our shields for learned RMDPs guarantee safety in unknown MDPs while recovering strong expected return as the number of samples increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）的安全屏蔽框架，在未知转移概率下保证强化学习代理的安全性，并证明其既合理又最优。
AI.motivation: 现有屏蔽技术通常需要知道安全相关的转移动态，这在实践中很少满足。本文旨在解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 将屏蔽技术扩展到鲁棒MDP（RMDP）中，将安全性定义为在最坏转移概率下以一定阈值概率满足线性时序逻辑公式。结合PAC保证的采样方法学习转移概率，构建屏蔽。
AI.result: 实验表明，在未知MDP中，基于学习RMDP构建的屏蔽能保证安全性，并随着样本量增加恢复强期望回报。
AI.conclusion: 该屏蔽框架对RMDP是合理且最优的：策略通过屏蔽即安全，反之所有安全策略均可通过屏蔽。
idea_en: A shielding framework for robust MDPs (RMDPs) that guarantees safety under worst-case transition probabilities without requiring prior knowledge of transition dynamics.
A method combining PAC-based sampling with RMDP shielding to construct safety guarantees for learned MDPs with high confidence.
A sound and optimal shield mechanism that ensures every admissible policy is safe and every safe policy is admissible in RMDPs.
A technique for enforcing Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) safety constraints with threshold probability in robust MDP environments.
A minimally restrictive shielding approach that recovers strong expected return as sample size increases in unknown MDPs.
idea_ch: 一种针对鲁棒MDP（RMDP）的屏蔽框架，无需先验了解转移动态即可在最坏转移概率下保证安全性
一种结合PAC采样的RMDP屏蔽方法，以高置信度为学习到的MDP构建安全保障
一种在RMDP中既合理又最优的屏蔽机制，确保所有可接受的策略都是安全的，且所有安全策略都是可接受的
一种在鲁棒MDP环境中强制执行带有阈值概率的线性时序逻辑（LTL）安全约束的技术
一种最小限制性的屏蔽方法，在未知MDP中随样本量增加恢复强期望回报

title: On Wednesdays, We Ask Questions: Optimizing "Active Listening" in Automated Legal Triage and Referral
comment: Working paper submitted as accepted to AIDA2J workshop at International Conference for AI and Law in Singapore, June 2026
summary: The FETCH classifier generates follow-up questions to help refine the best match for the applicant's legal problem, using a low-cost ensemble of LLMs. In this paper, we describe an expert attorney and LLM-assisted evaluation of the follow-up question approach in FETCH and show that while low-cost LLMs perform well at classification tasks, generating high-quality plain-language questions in this setting appears to require a more sophisticated and higher-cost model. Through discussion with legal intake workers, we propose a rubric for the evaluation of legal intake classification questions, and we find that prompt engineering alone is not enough to improve question quality for intake purposes. We also find that LLM-as-judge and human ratings diverge. We demonstrate that with the addition of a single high-cost model, GPT-5, the classifier can elicit relevant information from applicants for legal help, and that the questions lead to more accurate performance at classification tasks. We also find uneven fact elicitation across different categories, including domestic violence, at odds with family law screening protocols, suggesting the value of including dedicated screening panels for certain areas of law.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了FETCH分类器，该分类器利用低成本LLM集成生成后续问题以优化法律问题匹配。研究表明低成本LLM在分类任务上表现良好，但生成高质量法律问题需要更昂贵模型（GPT-5）。通过法律工作者讨论提出评估标准，发现提示工程不足以提升问题质量，且LLM评估与人工评估存在分歧。添加GPT-5后分类器表现提升，但某些法律领域（如家庭暴力）的事实获取不均衡，建议引入专门筛选机制。
AI.motivation: 法律咨询申请中，申请人难以准确描述法律问题，现有分类系统缺乏引导性提问机制。低成本的LLM能否生成有效的后续问题以提升法律问题匹配精度，是一个待解决的问题。
AI.method: 采用专家律师和LLM联合评估方法，对比不同成本模型（低成本LLM集成 vs GPT-5）生成的后续问题质量；通过法律工作者讨论制定评估标准；使用LLM-as-judge与人工评估进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 低成本LLM在分类任务中表现良好，但生成高质量法律问题需要更高成本模型（GPT-5）；提示工程无法改善问题质量；LLM评估与人工评估存在显著分歧；不同法律领域的事实获取效果不均，家庭暴力等敏感领域存在不足。
AI.conclusion: 法律分类系统中生成高质量后续问题需要高成本模型；需要针对特定法律领域设计专门筛选面板；LLM-as-judge不能完全替代人工评估。
idea_en: A legal intake classification method using a hybrid low-cost LLM ensemble for initial classification followed by a high-cost LLM (e.g., GPT-5) for generating follow-up questions to refine applicant legal problem matching.
A rubric-based evaluation framework specifically designed for assessing the quality of plain-language follow-up questions generated by LLMs in legal intake scenarios.
A legal intake system with dedicated screening panels for specific areas of law (e.g., domestic violence) to address uneven fact elicitation found in general LLM-based approaches.
idea_ch: 一种混合式法律受理分类方法：先用低成本LLM集成进行初步分类，再使用高成本LLM（如GPT-5）生成后续问题以优化法律问题匹配
一种专门针对法律受理场景中LLM生成的通俗语言后续问题质量的评估框架（基于法律工作者讨论制定的评估标准）
一种带有专门筛选面板的法律受理系统，针对特定法律领域（如家庭暴力）设计专用模块，以解决通用LLM方法中事实获取不均衡的问题

title: Evaluating Bivariate Causal Statements Based on Mutual Compatibility
summary: For many real-world systems, causal ground truth is difficult to obtain, making claims about causal effects hard to assess. We develop methods for evaluating collections of $\binom{n}{2}$ bivariate causal statements over a set of $n$ variables. In the setting of acyclic linear statements, any such collection can be extended to a unique multivariate causal model, but we argue that this induced model is implausible if it imposes substantial additional confounding to explain observed correlations. We introduce a compatibility score that quantifies this notion of plausibility, notably without relying on the faithfulness assumption. Additionally, we define an incompatibility score for purely graphical bivariate causal statements, based on global consistency constraints that are derived from acyclicity and faithfulness assumptions. We give theoretical and empirical evidence that both scores can successfully distinguish correct from incorrect causal statements in generic settings. Moreover, we demonstrate the practical applicability of our methods by analyzing causal claims made by large language models. Our work aims to provide a foundation for assessing the reliability of causal information derived from human experts or artificial intelligence in settings where alternative forms of validation are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种评分方法来评估成对因果陈述的可信度，无需真实因果标签，适用于人类专家或AI生成的因果信息验证。
AI.motivation: 现实系统中难以获取因果真相，需要一种无需ground truth即可评估因果陈述可信度的方法。
AI.method: 1) 兼容性评分：将二元因果陈述扩展为多元因果模型，通过评估所需额外混杂程度来衡量合理性；2) 不兼容性评分：基于无环性和忠实性假设的全局一致性约束，用于纯图形式的因果陈述。
AI.result: 理论和实验表明两种评分能在通用设置中有效区分正确与错误的因果陈述，并成功应用于评估LLM生成的因果断言。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种在缺乏验证手段时评估因果信息可靠性的基础方法，适用于人类专家或AI系统。
idea_en: A method for evaluating bivariate causal statements by measuring the additional confounding required in an induced multivariate causal model
A compatibility score for causal claims that operates without relying on the faithfulness assumption
An incompatibility score for graphical causal statements based on global consistency constraints from acyclicity and faithfulness
A framework for assessing reliability of causal information from large language models without ground truth labels
idea_ch: 一种通过衡量诱导多元因果模型中所需额外混杂程度来评估二元因果陈述的方法
一种不依赖忠实性假设的因果主张兼容性评分方法
基于无环性和忠实性全局一致性约束的图形式因果陈述不兼容性评分
一种无需真实标签即可评估大语言模型因果信息可靠性的框架

title: Model-Native Computing Architecture: Envisioning Future System Architecture Through the Lens of Computer Architecture
summary:
Large language models are undergoing a transition from model technology to system technology. As developers use Codex, Claude Code, AutoGPT, and related agents to write code, manage projects, and execute multi-step tasks, recurring engineering problems such as cache reuse, context management, agent scheduling, and permission control increasingly resemble classical computer systems problems. This paper develops that analogy as a visionary survey. We map concepts from computer architecture to the emerging model-native stack and review work on LLM-as-OS, memory management, agent frameworks, tool protocols, multi-agent coordination, cognitive architectures, and safety governance. We argue that these strands address different layers of the same system but lack a unified model.
  To fill this gap, we propose the Intelligent Computing Architecture Model (ICAM), a six-layer framework for model-native computing with explicit interface contracts and design axioms. ICAM resolves the apparent tension over whether an LLM is more like a CPU or an operating system through a dual-plane view: a probabilistic execution plane concerned with what can be computed, and a deterministic control plane concerned with what should be computed. We further introduce three design laws: the Semantic Locality Law for KV-cache reuse and inference speedup, the Context Budget Law for effective working sets under finite windows and attention decay, and the Agent Speedup Law for diminishing returns in multi-agent collaboration. We validate these laws against published system-level data and relate them to recent evidence on agentic software practices. We conclude by identifying where the analogy breaks down and outlining a research roadmap for model-native computing. This is a conceptual and survey contribution; it does not report new experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出智能计算架构模型(ICAM)，将LLM系统类比计算机体系结构，建立六层框架和三条设计定律，为模型原生计算提供统一视角。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM从模型技术向系统技术转变，缓存复用、上下文管理、Agent调度、权限控制等问题缺乏统一的系统级理论框架，现有研究分散在不同层面但缺乏统一模型。
AI.method: 采用愿景式综述方法，映射计算机体系结构概念到模型原生堆栈，提出ICAM六层框架，引入双平面视图（概率执行平面与确定性控制平面），提出三条设计定律（语义局部性定律、上下文预算定律、Agent加速定律）。
AI.result: 构建了统一的ICAM框架，三条设计定律经系统级数据验证，明确了模型原生计算的类比边界和研究路线图。
AI.conclusion: LLM系统设计可借鉴计算机体系结构成熟理论，但存在本质区别（概率性vs确定性），需要新的设计原理和工程范式。
idea_en: Intelligent Computing Architecture Model (ICAM): A six-layer framework for model-native computing with explicit interface contracts and design axioms, enabling standardized system design for LLM-based applications.

Dual-plane architecture separating probabilistic execution plane (what can be computed) from deterministic control plane (what should be computed) for LLM systems, analogous to CPU/OS separation in classical computers.
Semantic Locality Law for KV-cache reuse optimization: Formal principle describing how semantically related token sequences exhibit locality patterns that can predict and optimize cache hit rates.
Context Budget Law for finite-window attention management: Mathematical framework defining effective working sets under context window constraints and attention decay patterns.
Agent Speedup Law for multi-agent collaboration: Formal model describing diminishing returns in multi-agent systems with increasing agent count.
idea_ch: 智能计算架构模型(ICAM)：面向模型原生计算的六层框架，定义显式接口契约和设计公理，为LLM应用提供标准化系统设计方法
双平面架构：将LLM系统分为概率执行平面（可计算什么）和确定性控制平面（应计算什么），类比经典计算机中CPU/OS的分离设计
语义局部性定律：基于语义相关性的KV缓存复用优化形式化原理，可预测和优化缓存命中率
上下文预算定律：针对有限窗口和注意力衰减的上下文预算管理数学框架，定义有效工作集边界
Agent加速定律：多Agent协作中边际收益递减的形式化模型，指导最优Agent数量配置

title: Coupling Language Models with Physics-based Simulation for Synthesis of Inorganic Materials
comment: Accepted to the AI for Accelerated Materials Design (AI4Mat) Workshop at Neurips 2025
summary: Modern generative machine learning (ML) models can propose novel inorganic crystalline materials with targeted properties; however, synthesis planning of these materials remains difficult due to the complexity of the associated physical processes and limited availability of computational tools. We introduce a novel hybrid framework to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) in inorganic synthesis planning by combining thermodynamic databases with simplified kinetics models to approximate realistic synthesis conditions. As a case study, we focus on the niobium-oxygen system, which features multiple industrially relevant oxide phases with well-characterized data. In computational simulations, we compare LLM-generated synthesis routes with classical path-planning algorithms, showing that the implicit priors in LLMs can yield more viable strategies. In our evaluation setting, classical search methods serve primarily as a foil rather than a direct competitor. This illustrates the relative complexity of the problem and highlights where the LLM's implicit priors add value.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种混合框架，通过结合热力学数据库和简化动力学模型来评估LLM在无机材料合成规划中的表现，以铌氧系统为案例，发现LLM的隐式先验能产生更可行的合成策略。
AI.motivation: 现代生成式ML模型可以提出具有目标性质的新型无机晶体材料，但这些材料的合成规划仍然困难，因为相关物理过程复杂且计算工具有限。
AI.method: 提出一种混合框架，将热力学数据库与简化动力学模型相结合，以近似模拟真实合成条件，用于评估LLM在无机合成规划中的能力。以铌氧系统为案例，在计算模拟中比较LLM生成的合成路线与经典路径规划算法。
AI.result: LLM生成的合成路线比经典路径规划算法更可行，LLM的隐式先验能产生更具可行性的策略。经典搜索方法主要作为对照而非直接竞争对手。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了LLM在无机材料合成规划中的潜力，LLM的隐式先验在解决复杂合成问题中具有独特价值。
idea_en: A hybrid evaluation framework combining thermodynamic databases with simplified kinetics models to assess LLM performance in inorganic synthesis planning
LLM-guided inorganic synthesis route generation method leveraging implicit priors for more viable strategies compared to classical path-planning algorithms
A computational simulation system for comparing LLM-generated synthesis routes with classical search algorithms in material synthesis planning
Targeted application of LLMs to niobium-oxygen system synthesis planning with multiple industrially relevant oxide phases
idea_ch: 结合热力学数据库与简化动力学模型的混合框架，用于评估LLM在无机材料合成规划中的性能
利用LLM隐式先验引导无机合成路线生成的方法，相比经典路径规划算法能产生更可行的策略
一种计算模拟系统，用于比较LLM生成的合成路线与经典搜索算法在材料合成规划中的效果
针对铌氧系统（含多种工业相关氧化物相）的LLM定向合成规划应用方法

title: From Noise to Control: Parameterized Diffusion Policies
summary: We propose Parameterized Diffusion Policy (PDP), a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold. By constructing this manifold so that distances between latent representations reflect the semantic similarity between physical trajectories, we transform diffusion from a mechanism for stochastic diversity into a precise and optimizable tool for behavior steering. Our approach enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights. We demonstrate that PDP significantly improves adaptation performance on complex multimodal benchmarks in both simulated and real-robot experiments compared to standard diffusion policies, particularly in scenarios requiring the synthesis of novel behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出参数化扩散策略(PDP)，通过在学习的流形中嵌入低维连续参数来条件化扩散策略，实现行为平滑插值和高效适应新约束，无需更新策略权重。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散策略将随机多样性作为行为生成机制，难以精确控制和优化行为，且在新约束下需要更新策略权重，适应性差。
AI.method: 构建一个学习到的行为流形，其中潜在表示之间的距离反映物理轨迹之间的语义相似性；基于此流形用低维连续参数对扩散策略进行条件化，将扩散从随机多样性机制转变为精确可优化的行为操控工具。
AI.result: 在复杂多模态基准测试和真实机器人实验中，PDP相比标准扩散策略显著提升了适应性能，尤其是在需要合成新行为的场景中。
AI.conclusion: PDP框架通过参数化流形将扩散策略转化为可优化工具，实现了无需权重更新的高效行为适应与插值，为机器人行为策略的灵活控制提供了新范式。
idea_en: A method for constructing a learned behavior manifold where distances between latent representations correspond to semantic similarity between physical trajectories, enabling parametric control of diffusion policy outputs.

A parameterized diffusion policy framework that conditions on low-dimensional continuous parameters embedded in the behavior manifold, allowing smooth interpolation between known strategies without weight updates.
A technique for transforming stochastic diffusion processes into optimizable behavior steering tools by leveraging semantic latent spaces for policy conditioning.
A system for adapting diffusion policies to novel constraints by optimizing over continuous conditioning parameters instead of retraining model weights.
A method for synthesizing novel robot behaviors by interpolating within a learned behavior manifold using parameterized diffusion models.
idea_ch: 一种构建学习型行为流形的方法，其中潜在表示之间的距离反映物理轨迹之间的语义相似性，实现对扩散策略输出的参数化控制。
一种参数化扩散策略框架，通过在行为流形中嵌入低维连续参数进行条件化，无需权重更新即可实现已知策略之间的平滑插值。
一种利用语义潜在空间进行策略条件化，将随机扩散过程转化为可优化的行为操控工具的技术。
一种通过优化连续条件参数而非重新训练模型权重，使扩散策略适应新约束的系统。
一种利用参数化扩散模型在学习的行为流形内进行插值，从而合成新型机器人行为的方法。

title: From "Weak" Signals to Strong Models: Preference Delta Aggregation with LoRA Merging
summary: Training strong large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality supervision, which is often scarce. Recent work shows that paired preference data from weak-weaker model pairs (e.g., Qwen3 4B over 1.7B), despite the limited quality of individual responses, can provide an effective supervision signal through relative quality deltas, which we term a "weak" signal. This motivates a key research question: can multiple "weak" signals be constructively aggregated for improving strong models (e.g., Qwen3 8B)? To this end, we propose Preference Delta Aggregation (PDA), the first framework that derives a preference delta from each weak-weaker model pair, instantiates it as a LoRA adapter learned through preference optimization, and aggregates the resulting deltas via LoRA merging. To further mitigate directional interference during LoRA merging, we introduce Geometric Alignment Merging (GAM), a geometry-aware merging method that aligns adapter subspaces before aggregation, enabling more robust composition of diverse deltas. Evaluations on knowledge reasoning and agentic search benchmarks show that aggregating multiple "weak" signals pushes performance beyond any single signal, with further gains as additional signals are incorporated. Correspondingly, PDA with GAM improves the strong model by 6.8 and 7.3 points on average for knowledge reasoning and agentic search, respectively. It outperforms all single-delta and multi-delta baselines, exceeding the best single-delta baseline by 2.1 and 4.3 points. Further analysis attributes these gains to the effective composition of complementary capabilities encoded across distinct preference deltas.

AI.tldr: 提出偏好增量聚合（PDA）框架，通过从弱-更弱模型对中提取偏好增量（以LoRA适配器表示），并利用几何对齐合并（GAM）进行聚合，从而利用多个弱信号提升强LLM性能。
AI.motivation: 高质量监督信号稀缺，而弱-更弱模型对提供的相对质量增量（弱信号）虽然单个质量有限，但可通过聚合多个弱信号来有效提升强模型性能。
AI.method: 1）从每个弱-更弱模型对中推导偏好增量，通过偏好优化实例化为LoRA适配器；2）提出几何对齐合并（GAM），在对齐适配器子空间后进行LoRA合并，减少方向干扰。
AI.result: 在知识推理和智能体搜索任务上，PDA+GAM相比最佳单增量基线分别提升2.1和4.3个点，平均提升6.8和7.3个点，且随信号数量增加性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 多个弱信号能通过互补能力编码实现有效聚合，PDA框架为利用弱监督信号提供了可扩展的新范式。
idea_en: A method for aggregating multiple weak preference signals from weak-weaker model pairs by converting each relative quality delta into a LoRA adapter via preference optimization, and merging them to improve a stronger target model.

A geometry-aware merging method (Geometric Alignment Merging, GAM) that aligns the subspaces of multiple LoRA adapters before aggregation to mitigate directional interference and enable robust composition of diverse preference deltas.
A preference delta extraction pipeline that derives a 'relative quality delta' from each weak-weaker model pair (e.g., Qwen3 4B vs 1.7B) as a training signal for preference optimization.

A multi-source weak signal aggregation framework that leverages complementary capabilities encoded across distinct preference deltas, allowing performance to scale with the number of added weak signals.
A LoRA-based representation of preference deltas from model comparisons, enabling modular and composable storage of pairwise improvement directions.
idea_ch: 一种从弱-更弱模型对中提取多个弱偏好信号的方法：将每个相对质量增量通过偏好优化转换为LoRA适配器，再合并以提升更强的目标模型。
一种几何对齐合并方法（GAM）：在聚合前对齐多个LoRA适配器的子空间，减少方向干扰，实现鲁棒的多样性偏好增量组合。
偏好增量提取流水线：从每个弱-更弱模型对（如Qwen3 4B vs 1.7B）中推导出'相对质量增量'，作为偏好优化的训练信号。
多源弱信号聚合框架：利用不同偏好增量中编码的互补能力，使性能随添加的弱信号数量增加而提升。
基于LoRA的偏好增量表示方法：将模型对比中的成对改进方向存储为模块化、可组合的LoRA适配器。

title: The Deterministic Horizon: When Extended Reasoning Fails and Tool Delegation Becomes Necessary
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 4 figures. 51 pages including appendices
summary: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning can degrade performance on deterministic state-tracking tasks, not due to preference biases, but limits rooted in the information-theoretic capacity of decoder-only attention. We establish: (1) an Attention Bottleneck Theorem with a complementary achievability construction, bounding state-tracking capacity as $O(H \cdot \log(L/H) \cdot \sqrt{d_h})$; (2) a context-dependent error model yielding super-exponential accuracy decay; (3) the State-Space Jaccard metric distinguishing capability from preference failures; (4) a Deterministic Horizon $d^* \in [19, 31]$ beyond which tool delegation becomes necessary. Across 12 models and 8 task domains (including SWE-Bench, WebArena, and SQL-Multi), tool-integrated reasoning consistently outperforms neural chain-of-thought; on the primary model suite it reaches 86-94% accuracy versus 24-42% for neural chain-of-thought. Fine-tuning on optimal-length traces yields $<$5% improvement, confirming an architectural ceiling, and high cross-model correlation ($r = 0.81$-$0.91$) indicates these failures are architectural rather than training-specific. Our results provide principled guidance for when pure neural reasoning should yield to hybrid approaches in agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了解码器-only注意力机制在确定性状态追踪任务中存在信息论容量瓶颈，理论边界为O(H·log(L/H)·√d_h)，并发现当任务确定性复杂度超过阈值d*∈[19,31]时，纯神经推理必然失效，工具增强的混合方法可达到86-94%准确率。
AI.motivation: 探究扩展链式推理（Chain-of-Thought）在确定性状态追踪任务中性能下降的根本原因，区分架构性限制与偏好偏差，为混合智能系统设计提供理论指导。
AI.method: 提出了注意力瓶颈定理（Attention Bottleneck Theorem）及其可达性构造，建立了上下文相关误差模型导出超指数精度衰减，定义了状态空间Jaccard度量（State-Space Jaccard metric）用于区分能力失效与偏好失效，并通过12个模型、8个任务域（SWE-Bench, WebArena, SQL-Multi等）进行大规模实验验证。
AI.result: 工具集成推理在主要模型套件上达到86-94%准确率，而纯神经链式推理仅24-42%；在最优长度轨迹上微调仅带来<5%改进；跨模型相关性高（r=0.81-0.91），确认失效是架构性的而非训练特定的。
AI.conclusion: 确定性状态追踪任务存在架构性天花板，确定性视界d*∈[19,31]之后纯神经推理应让位于工具增强的混合方法，为智能体系统设计提供了原则性指导。
idea_en: Attention Bottleneck Theorem with achievability construction for bounding state-tracking capacity in decoder-only attention
Context-dependent error model that predicts super-exponential accuracy decay in deterministic state tracking
State-Space Jaccard metric for distinguishing capability failures from preference failures in LLM reasoning
Deterministic Horizon threshold (d* ∈ [19,31]) for determining when tool delegation is necessary in agentic systems
Hybrid architecture combining neural chain-of-thought with tool-integrated reasoning for exceeding the attention bottleneck ceiling
idea_ch: 基于注意力瓶颈定理的解码器-only状态追踪容量边界方法（O(H·log(L/H)·√d_h)）及可达性构造技术
上下文相关误差模型：用于预测确定性状态追踪中超指数精度衰减的评估方法
状态空间Jaccard度量：区分大语言模型推理中能力失效与偏好失效的新型评估指标
确定性视界阈值技术：确定d*∈[19,31]范围内何时需要工具委派的决策机制
神经链式推理与工具集成推理的混合架构：突破注意力瓶颈架构性天花板的方法

title: VESTA: Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents
