title: Self-Revising Discovery Systems for Science: A Categorical Framework for Agentic Artificial Intelligence
summary: Scientific discovery is not only answer generation but revision of the representational regime in which evidence, artifacts, operations, and verifiers are typed. We develop a category-theoretic account of agentic discovery for materials science. In a fixed regime b with schema category S_b, the system state is a copresheaf I_t: S_b -> Set, and provenance is the category of elements \int_{S_b} I_t. Fixed-regime operation is an update on such states, endofunctorial only when provenance-preserving refinements are specified and preserved. Discovery is instead a verified regime transition u: S_b -> S_b': old artifacts are preserved, transported by the left Kan extension Lan_u I_t, and compared with the post-transition state to identify residual content beyond functorial transport. This separates retrieval, search, and discovery without subjective novelty. We instantiate the framework in two systems. In Builder/Breaker, a protein-mechanics world model is revised under a Minimum Description Length gate; the accepted law expresses within-chain flexibility as all-mode elastic compliance conditioned by slow collective-mode participation, or mode-conditioned compliance. In CategoryScienceClaw, typed skills, artifacts, open needs, workflow mutation, gates, stress tests, and public discourse become a proof-carrying knowledge-computation graph. A fiber-network example records candidate models, rejected alternatives, an AIC gate, perturbation tests, and an accepted orientation-tensor anisotropic stiffness surrogate over an isotropic fiber-count descriptor. Together, the cases show how category theory can be both a mathematical language for discovery and an engineering specification for self-revising AI discovery systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于范畴论（category theory）的自主科学发现框架，将科学发现定义为表征体制的转变（regime transition），而非简单的答案生成。通过左Kan扩展等范畴论工具，实现了检索、搜索和发现的分离，并在蛋白质力学和纤维网络两个系统中实例化。
AI.motivation: 现有AI发现系统主要关注答案生成，忽略了科学发现中表征体制（包括证据、人工产物、操作和验证器的类型化）的修订。需要一种既能作为数学语言描述发现过程，又能作为工程规范指导自修正AI系统设计的框架。
AI.method: 1. 定义固定体制b下的系统状态为copresheaf I_t: S_b -> Set，溯源为该范畴的元素范畴。2. 固定体制操作是状态更新，仅在指定并保持溯源精炼时才是endofunctorial。3. 发现被定义为经过验证的体制转换u: S_b -> S_b'，通过左Kan扩展Lan_u I_t保留旧人工产物并与新状态比较，识别超出函子传输的残余内容。4. 在Builder/Breaker系统中使用MDL门控进行蛋白质力学世界模型修订；在CategoryScienceClaw中构建带证明的知识计算图。
AI.result: 1. Builder/Breaker系统：接受链内柔性作为全模态弹性顺应性（由慢集体模态参与度调节），即模态条件化顺应性。2. CategoryScienceClaw系统：纤维网络案例记录了候选模型、被拒替代方案、AIC门控、扰动测试，以及接受的取向张量各向异性刚度替代模型（基于各向同性纤维计数描述符）。
AI.conclusion: 范畴论既可以作为科学发现的数学语言，也可以作为自修正AI发现系统的工程规范。框架成功分离了检索、搜索和发现，避免了主观新颖性判断。
idea_en: A category-theoretic framework for scientific discovery as verified regime transition, using left Kan extension to preserve and transport old artifacts across representational regime changes
Builder/Breaker system: Minimum Description Length (MDL) gated revision of protein mechanics world model with mode-conditioned compliance as accepted law
CategoryScienceClaw: proof-carrying knowledge-computation graph integrating typed skills, artifacts, open needs, workflow mutation, gates, stress tests, and public discourse
Fiber-network modeling with AIC gate, perturbation tests, and orientation-tensor anisotropic stiffness surrogate over isotropic fiber-count descriptor
Provenance-preserving refinements as endofunctorial state update mechanism for fixed-regime scientific operations
Method for separating retrieval, search, and discovery by comparing post-transition state with left Kan extension of pre-transition state
idea_ch: 基于范畴论的科学发现表征体制转换框架：通过左Kan扩展在表征体制变更时保留和传输旧人工产物
Builder/Breaker系统：基于最小描述长度(MDL)门控的蛋白质力学世界模型修订，以模态条件化顺应性为接受定律
CategoryScienceClaw系统：带证明的知识计算图，集成类型化技能、人工产物、开放需求、工作流变异、门控、压力测试和公共讨论
纤维网络建模方法：使用AIC门控、扰动测试，以及基于各向同性纤维计数描述符的取向张量各向异性刚度替代模型
保持溯源精炼的endofunctorial状态更新机制，用于固定体制下的科学操作
通过比较新状态与旧状态的左Kan扩展来分离检索、搜索和发现的方法

title: A Minimalist Brain-Computer Musical Interface for Real-Time Emotion-Driven Sonification: System Design and Preliminary Evaluation
summary: This paper presents a minimalist brain-computer Musical Interface (BCMI) that functions as a real-time affective sonification system, translating prefrontal EEG activity into adaptive music. Emotional valence is estimated from frontal alpha asymmetry (AF7/AF8) and mapped to musical features such as mode, tempo, rhythmic density, and pitch register through a stochastic generative algorithm. The system integrates wireless EEG acquisition, real-time Python signal processing, and Ableton Live-based music generation synchronized via Lab Streaming Layer. An experiment with 22 participants investigated whether intentional emotional self-induction could modulate the BCMI neurofeedback signal. Linear mixed-effects analyses found no significant effects of target emotion or time, indicating that the frontal alpha asymmetry signal did not reliably distinguish instructed emotional states. Individual differences, including musical training and acting experience, explained more variance than the experimental manipulation, which accounted for only 0.40\% of total signal variance. These findings highlight the challenges of using frontal alpha asymmetry as a voluntary control signal for closed-loop emotion regulation and suggest methodological directions for future BCMI research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于前额EEG alpha不对称性的极简脑机音乐接口(BCMI)，通过随机生成算法将情感效价映射为音乐特征，但实验表明该神经反馈信号无法可靠区分受试者有意识引导的情绪状态，个体差异远大于实验操纵的效果。
AI.motivation: 探索利用前额EEG alpha不对称性作为实时情感神经反馈信号，构建闭环脑机音乐接口(BCMI)，实现情感状态到自适应音乐的实时映射。
AI.method: 采用无线EEG采集设备获取前额AF7/AF8通道信号，计算frontal alpha不对称性作为情感效价指标；通过随机生成算法将效价值映射到音乐的模式、速度、节奏密度和音域等特征；使用Python实时信号处理，通过Lab Streaming Layer与Ableton Live同步生成音乐。22名参与者进行有意识情绪自我诱导实验，采用线性混合效应模型分析。
AI.result: 目标情绪或时间对神经反馈信号无显著影响，frontal alpha不对称性无法可靠区分受试者有意识诱导的情绪状态。个体差异（音乐训练、表演经验）解释的方差远大于实验操纵（仅占0.40%总信号方差）。
AI.conclusion: 前额alpha不对称性作为闭环情绪调节的自愿控制信号面临重大挑战，需探索更可靠的情感神经标记用于BCMI系统。
idea_en: A real-time affective sonification system that maps prefrontal EEG frontal alpha asymmetry (AF7/AF8) to musical features (mode, tempo, rhythmic density, pitch register) via a stochastic generative algorithm, integrated with wireless EEG, Python signal processing, and Ableton Live synchronized via Lab Streaming Layer.

A closed-loop BCMI neurofeedback architecture where emotional valence estimated from EEG is translated into adaptive music in real-time, enabling potential emotion self-regulation through auditory feedback.
A method combining frontal alpha asymmetry calculation with stochastic music generation for mapping continuous emotional valence estimates to discrete musical parameter changes.
idea_ch: 基于前额EEG alpha不对称性（AF7/AF8通道）并通过随机生成算法实时映射到音乐特征（调式、速度、节奏密度、音域）的情感声化系统，集成无线EEG采集、Python实时信号处理和基于Lab Streaming Layer同步的Ableton Live音乐生成。
闭环BCMI神经反馈架构，将EEG估计的情感效价实时转化为自适应音乐，通过听觉反馈实现潜在的情绪自我调节。
结合前额alpha不对称性计算与随机音乐生成的方法，将连续情感效价估计映射为离散音乐参数变化。

title: Joint Agent Memory and Exploration Learning via Novelty Signals
summary: In open-ended environments, exploration is fundamental for autonomous agents, yet current language model agents struggle with this. Effective exploration requires memory, but retaining raw interaction histories is computationally expensive over long trajectories. While latent memory offers a solution to compress interaction histories, its training lacks reliable supervisory signals. We introduce \textbf{J}oint \textbf{A}gent \textbf{M}emory and \textbf{E}xploration \textbf{L}earning (\textbf{JAMEL}), a framework that trains agentic memory and exploration policy together through novelty-driven interaction. We observe that memory and exploration form a mutually dependent loop: sustained exploration requires memory to distinguish exhausted behaviors from unseen ones, while novelty-seeking interaction provides the supervision needed to make memory useful for future exploration. By utilizing deterministic and persistent novelty signals such as code coverage in the GUI domain, we provide natural, annotation-free supervision for the memory module. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that \ours successfully generalizes to unseen environments. Its exploration capability outperforms open-weight baselines and rivals the exploration depth of a closed-source model while reducing token consumption. Our code and model are open-sourced at https://github.com/MobileLLM/JAMEL.

AI.tldr: JAMEL提出了一种联合训练智能体记忆和探索策略的框架，通过新奇性驱动交互（如GUI中的代码覆盖率）提供无监督信号，实现高效探索和记忆压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型智能体在开放环境中探索困难，因为原始交互历史存储计算成本高，而隐式记忆训练缺乏可靠的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出JAMEL框架，联合训练智能体记忆模块和探索策略。利用确定性且持久的新奇性信号（如GUI领域的代码覆盖率）作为记忆模块的自然无标注监督，形成记忆与探索的相互依赖循环：记忆帮助区分已探索/未探索行为，新奇性驱动的交互提供记忆训练信号。
AI.result: 在未见过的环境中成功泛化，探索能力优于开源基线模型，与闭源模型的探索深度相当，同时显著降低token消耗。
AI.conclusion: 记忆与探索可形成正反馈循环，利用领域特定的新奇性信号可实现无监督的记忆训练，提升智能体在开放环境中的探索效率。
idea_en: A method for jointly training agent memory module and exploration policy using novelty-driven interaction signals, where memory compression and exploration strategy are optimized in a mutually dependent loop.
Using deterministic and persistent novelty signals, such as code coverage in GUI environments, as annotation-free supervisory signals for training latent memory modules in language model agents.

A framework that leverages code coverage metrics from GUI interactions as a natural reward signal to guide exploration policy and simultaneously provide supervision for memory compression without human annotation.

A system architecture where a latent memory module compresses interaction histories and the compressed representations are used to distinguish exhausted behaviors from novel ones, enabling efficient long-horizon exploration.
idea_ch: 一种联合训练智能体记忆模块和探索策略的方法，利用新奇性驱动的交互信号，使记忆压缩和探索策略在相互依赖的循环中协同优化。
利用确定性且持久的新奇性信号（如GUI环境中的代码覆盖率）作为无标注监督信号，用于训练语言模型智能体的隐式记忆模块。
一种将GUI交互中的代码覆盖率指标作为自然奖励信号的框架，用于指导探索策略，同时为记忆压缩提供监督，无需人工标注。
一种系统架构，其中隐式记忆模块压缩交互历史，压缩后的表示用于区分已穷尽的行为和未见过的行为，从而实现高效的长时域探索。

title: RoleCDE:Benchmarking and Mitigating Role-Alignment Trade-offs in Role-Playing Agents
summary: Role-playing agents(RPAs) are widely used to steer large language models(LLMs) toward role-consistent behavior, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate surface-level fidelity and offer limited insight into decision making under role-alignment value conflicts. To address this gap, we introduce RoleCDE, the first benchmark designed to evaluate RPAs under structured conflicts between role-specific values and alignment-oriented constraints. RoleCDE formulates role-aware decision making as cognitive dilemma scenarios, jointly evaluating role-scenario grounding, value conflict resolution, and decision tendencies. The benchmark is constructed at scale, covering approximately 8k diverse role profiles and scenarios and nearly 24k dilemma instances across three difficulty levels and eight role categories. Evaluation of several mainstream LLMs reveals a "Role Value Decoupling" phenomenon, where agents systematically default to alignment-and morality-consistent decisions rather than role-specific values when the two conflict, even under explicit role conditioning. This behavior is largely invariant to dilemma difficulty but varies substantially across role categories. We further show that RoleCDE-based fine-tuning effectively mitigates this decoupling by improving value trade-off reasoning, while preserving general role-playing fidelity and general reasoning performance. Code is available at: https://github.com/rabbitrose/RoleCDE.

AI.tldr: 提出了RoleCDE，首个评估角色扮演代理在角色特定价值观与对齐约束冲突下决策的基准，包含约8000个角色画像、24000个困境实例，发现了"角色价值解耦"现象，并通过微调有效缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有角色扮演代理基准主要评估表面角色保真度，缺乏对角色对齐价值冲突下决策能力的评估，无法衡量代理在角色价值观与安全/道德对齐约束冲突时的权衡能力。
AI.method: 构建RoleCDE基准，将角色感知决策形式化为认知困境场景，联合评估角色场景定位、价值冲突解决和决策倾向；覆盖约8000个角色画像、24000个困境实例，包含三个难度级别和八个角色类别。
AI.result: 主流LLM显示出"角色价值解耦"现象：当角色价值观与对齐/道德约束冲突时，代理系统性地默认选择对齐和道德一致决策而非角色特定价值观；该行为对困境难度不敏感但随角色类别变化显著；基于RoleCDE的微调可有效缓解解耦现象。
AI.conclusion: RoleCDE填补了角色扮演代理在价值冲突决策评估方面的空白，揭示了角色价值解耦这一重要现象，并提供了有效的缓解方法。
idea_en: A benchmark for evaluating role-playing agents under structured conflicts between role-specific values and alignment-oriented constraints, using cognitive dilemma scenarios to jointly assess role-scenario grounding, value conflict resolution, and decision tendencies.
A method for constructing large-scale dilemma instances (approximately 24k) across three difficulty levels and eight role categories for comprehensive role-play decision evaluation.
A 'Role Value Decoupling' detection technique that identifies when agents systematically default to alignment-consistent decisions over role-specific values under conflict.
A fine-tuning approach using RoleCDE-based data to improve value trade-off reasoning in role-playing agents while preserving general role fidelity and reasoning performance.
idea_ch: 一种评估角色扮演代理在角色特定价值观与对齐约束之间结构化冲突下决策能力的基准测试方法，利用认知困境场景联合评估角色场景定位、价值冲突解决和决策倾向。
一种大规模困境实例构建方法，覆盖约24k个实例，包含三个难度级别和八个角色类别，用于综合评估角色扮演决策。
一种'角色价值解耦'检测技术，用于识别代理在价值冲突时系统性地默认选择对齐一致决策而非角色特定价值观的行为模式。
一种基于RoleCDE数据的微调方法，提升角色扮演代理在价值权衡推理方面的能力，同时保持通用角色保真度和推理性能。

title: S-SPPO: Semantic-Calibrated Self-Play Preference Optimization
summary: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences is often formulated via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). However, the standard Bradley-Terry instantiation of DPO is limited in modeling common departures from transitivity in human preferences. To address this, recent work has introduced Self-Play Preference Optimization (SPPO), which iteratively refines the policy by training on self-generated win-lose pairs. Our investigation, however, reveals a critical instability in SPPO: the optimization is prone to policy degeneration when the preference oracle assigns overly confident wins to semantically indistinguishable responses. To mitigate this, we propose S-SPPO, a dual-space semantic calibration framework comprising: i) Supervision Calibration via semantic gating, which anneals win rate targets toward the maximum-entropy baseline as semantic overlap increases; and ii) Representation Calibration via latent repulsion to enforce geometric diversity to prevent manifold collapse and maintain latent diversity between chosen and rejected samples. Theoretically, we show that the calibration preserves the constant-sum game structure, facilitating convergence to a Nash Equilibrium. Empirically, S-SPPO avoids the performance degradation seen in prior methods, achieving 52.19% win rate and 47.46% length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0 with Llama-3-8B, without using additional human-annotated preferences during training. The code will be available at https://github.com/xiwenc1/s-sppo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S-SPPO，一种双空间语义校准框架，解决SPPO在偏好优化中因语义相似导致策略退化的问题，通过语义门控校准和潜在表示排斥实现稳定优化，在AlpacaEval 2.0上取得52.19%胜率。
AI.motivation: 标准DPO基于Bradley-Terry模型，无法处理人类偏好中常见的非传递性。SPPO虽引入自我对弈优化，但当偏好oracle对语义不可区分的响应赋予过度置信的胜率时，会导致策略退化。
AI.method: 提出双空间语义校准框架S-SPPO：1) 监督校准：通过语义门控根据语义重叠程度将胜率目标退火至最大熵基线；2) 表示校准：通过潜在排斥强制几何多样性，防止流形坍塌，保持选定与拒绝样本之间的潜在多样性。
AI.result: S-SPPO避免了先前方法的性能退化，在AlpacaEval 2.0上使用Llama-3-8B达到52.19%胜率和47.46%长度控制胜率，无需使用额外人工标注偏好。
AI.conclusion: 理论证明该校准保留了常数和博弈结构，有助于收敛到纳什均衡。S-SPPO有效解决了SPPO的稳定性问题。
idea_en: A dual-space semantic calibration framework for preference optimization that includes supervision calibration via semantic gating to anneal win rate targets toward maximum-entropy baseline based on semantic overlap
A representation calibration mechanism using latent repulsion to enforce geometric diversity and prevent manifold collapse between chosen and rejected samples in preference learning
A method combining semantic-gated win rate annealing with latent space repulsion to maintain stable convergence to Nash Equilibrium in self-play preference optimization
A semantic overlap detection mechanism that dynamically adjusts preference optimization intensity to prevent policy degeneration when responses are semantically indistinguishable
idea_ch: 一种双空间语义校准偏好优化框架，通过语义门控根据语义重叠程度将胜率目标退火至最大熵基线，实现监督校准
一种基于潜在排斥的表示校准机制，强制选择与拒绝样本之间的几何多样性，防止流形坍塌
一种结合语义门控胜率退火与潜在空间排斥的方法，在自我对弈偏好优化中保持稳定收敛至纳什均衡
一种语义重叠检测机制，动态调整偏好优化强度，防止语义不可区分响应导致策略退化

title: TRON: Targeted Rule-Verifiable Online Environments for Visual Reasoning RL
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for visual reasoning needs scalable, verifiable, and controllable training signals. Existing visual RL post-training trains on static curated datasets, with fixed image-question-answer samples bounded by their collection budget. In this work, we introduce TRON (Targeted, Rule-verifiable Online eNvironments), an online environment substrate: a training rollout is generated on demand by a controllable generator-verifier program that samples a fresh latent visual state, renders an image, asks a question, and exactly verifies the answer. A single run can therefore draw an unbounded stream of fresh instances at the difficulty level required by the current curriculum. The current TRON suite contains 520 environments organized into five ability buckets (spatial, mathematical, diagram, pattern/logic, and counting); the same substrate supports both a single full model trained on all buckets and per-bucket ability-specialist models, with no additional data collection. We also introduce a substrate analysis covering generation reliability, instance and level diversity, cross-environment near-duplicates, and base-model pass rate by difficulty level. RL post-training with METHOD consistently improves performance on ten external multimodal reasoning benchmarks across Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and MiMo-VL-7B-SFT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRON，一个可控的在线环境生成框架，通过生成器-验证器程序动态生成视觉推理训练样本，支持无限制的、按需难度的训练数据流，显著提升多模态模型在外部基准上的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉RL后训练依赖静态 curated 数据集，样本受限于采集预算，无法提供可扩展、可验证、可控的训练信号。
AI.method: 构建TRON在线环境基板，包含520个环境，分为5个能力类别；由可控生成器-验证器程序按需生成训练样本，实时渲染图像、提问并验证答案；支持课程学习难度调节。
AI.result: RL后训练在Qwen3-VL-4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、MiMo-VL-7B-SFT上一致提升10个外部多模态推理基准的性能。
AI.conclusion: 在线动态生成训练样本的范式比静态数据集更有效，可扩展且无需额外数据收集成本。
idea_en: A controllable generator-verifier program for on-demand visual reasoning training sample generation, where latent visual states are sampled, images rendered, questions posed, and answers verified automatically in real-time.
An online environment substrate (TRON) with 520 environments organized into five ability buckets (spatial, mathematical, diagram, pattern/logic, counting) for curriculum-based reinforcement learning.

A per-bucket ability-specialist model training framework where specialist models are trained on specific ability buckets and can be combined with a generalist model for improved multi-modal reasoning.

A substrate analysis method for evaluating generation reliability, instance/level diversity, cross-environment near-duplicate detection, and base-model pass rate by difficulty level in dynamically generated visual reasoning datasets.
idea_ch: 一种可控的生成器-验证器程序，按需生成视觉推理训练样本，实时采样潜在视觉状态、渲染图像、提出视觉问题并自动验证答案。
一种包含520个环境、按五种能力类别（空间、数学、图表、模式/逻辑、计数）组织的在线环境基板TRON，支持基于课程学习的强化学习训练。
一种按能力类别训练专家模型的多模态推理框架，每个专家模型专注于特定能力桶，可与通用模型协同提升性能。
一种针对动态生成视觉推理数据集的基板分析方法，包括生成可靠性评估、实例与等级多样性分析、跨环境近似重复检测以及按难度级别的基础模型通过率评估。

title: Revisiting Ripple Effects in Knowledge Editing through Pressure-Aware Joint Neighborhood Optimization
summary: Single-edit updates in large language models can trigger ripple effects across local knowledge neighborhoods: desirable propagation to related facts and unintended perturbation of preserved ones. Existing methods address these two effects separately, without explicitly modeling their coupling. We challenge this separation through an analysis of ripple responses across typical baselines, identifying two coupled design pressures: editable-side coordination and preserved-side leakage. We propose Joint Neighborhood Optimization (JNO), a new knowledge-editing framework to formalize and jointly address both pressures at the target-planning stage. JNO instantiates this principle through Pressure-Aware Coordination (PAC), which jointly optimizes neighborhood target representations under coupled constraints, and a semantic pre-execution gate that rejects high-risk target plans before parameter execution. Experiments on RippleEdits show JNO improves propagation and preservation metrics by at least 7.0% while preserving cross-backbone editing stability.

AI.tldr: 提出联合邻域优化(JNO)框架，通过显式建模编辑侧协调与保留侧泄露两种耦合压力，在目标规划阶段联合优化邻域表征，同时引入语义预执行门控机制过滤高风险目标计划，实现知识编辑中相关事实传播与无关事实保留的协同优化。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法将相关事实的传播效应与无关事实的扰动效应分开处理，没有显式建模两者之间的耦合关系，导致单次编辑在知识邻域中产生非预期的级联影响。
AI.method: 提出Joint Neighborhood Optimization (JNO)框架，包含：1) Pressure-Aware Coordination (PAC)模块，在耦合约束下联合优化邻域目标表征；2) 语义预执行门控机制，在执行参数前过滤高风险目标计划。
AI.result: 在RippleEdits基准上，传播和保留指标提升至少7.0%，同时保持跨骨干网络的编辑稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模编辑侧协调与保留侧泄露两种耦合压力并在目标规划阶段联合优化，可以有效改善知识编辑的传播与保留效果。
idea_en: Joint Neighborhood Optimization (JNO) framework that formalizes and jointly addresses editable-side coordination and preserved-side leakage pressures during the target-planning stage
Pressure-Aware Coordination (PAC) module that jointly optimizes neighborhood target representations under coupled constraints
Semantic pre-execution gate that rejects high-risk target plans before parameter execution
Method for modeling the coupling between related fact propagation and unrelated fact preservation in knowledge editing
idea_ch: 联合邻域优化(JNO)框架：在目标规划阶段同时形式化处理编辑侧协调压力与保留侧泄露压力的知识编辑方法
压力感知协调(PAC)模块：在耦合约束下联合优化知识邻域目标表征的技术方案
语义预执行门控机制：在执行参数更新前对高风险目标计划进行语义级过滤的方法
知识编辑中相关事实传播与无关事实保留耦合关系的显式建模技术

title: ReSkill: Reconciling Skill Creation with Policy Optimization in Agentic RL
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables LLM agents to improve continuously from environment rewards, yet the resulting policies do not systematically accumulate reusable strategies that generalize across tasks. Modular skills can provide such reusable strategies, yet existing skill-augmented RL methods decouple skill creation from policy optimization, risking adopting skills that conflict with the evolving policy. Inspired by Anthropic's Skill Creator, we introduce ReSkill, an RL-in-the-loop skill creation framework that reconciles skill evolution with policy learning. ReSkill exploits the group-wise structure of GRPO to naturally embed three mechanisms with only marginal additional overhead: (1) an assertion-driven skill creator that diagnoses failures from past experience and proposes conditional, trigger-based skill revisions; (2) within-group rollout sampling that enables controlled comparison of skill versions, capturing which version best supports the policy's ongoing learning; and (3) Thompson Sampling with adaptive discounting to balance exploration and exploitation in skill version selection as the policy evolves. Across several domains, ReSkill consistently outperforms existing memory and skill-based RL methods, with the largest gains on unseen tasks. Analysis of the skill lifecycle shows skills being automatically created, tested, refined, and pruned as the policy improves, demonstrating reconciled skill-policy co-evolution.

AI.tldr: ReSkill是一种将技能创建嵌入强化学习循环的框架，利用GRPO的群组结构实现技能与策略的协同进化，在多个领域优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强的RL方法将技能创建与策略优化解耦，导致技能与演进中的策略可能产生冲突，缺乏系统性积累可复用策略的能力。
AI.method: ReSkill基于GRPO的群组结构嵌入三种机制：(1)断言驱动的技能创建器，从失败中诊断问题并提出条件性触发式技能修订；(2)组内轨迹采样，实现技能版本的受控对比；(3)带自适应折扣的汤普森采样，平衡技能版本选择的探索与利用。
AI.result: 在多个领域，ReSkill持续优于现有基于记忆和技能的RL方法，在未见任务上提升最大。技能生命周期分析显示技能随策略改进自动创建、测试、精炼和剪枝。
AI.conclusion: ReSkill成功实现了技能与策略的协同进化，证明了将技能创建嵌入RL循环的有效性。
idea_en: A reinforcement-learning-in-the-loop skill creation framework that exploits group-wise structure of GRPO to embed assertion-driven skill creation, within-group rollout sampling, and Thompson Sampling with adaptive discounting for skill version selection.
An assertion-driven skill creator that diagnoses failures from past experience and proposes conditional, trigger-based skill revisions for LLM agents.
A within-group rollout sampling mechanism enabling controlled comparison of different skill versions during policy optimization, capturing which version best supports ongoing policy learning.
A Thompson Sampling method with adaptive discounting to balance exploration and exploitation in skill version selection as the policy evolves.
A skill lifecycle management system where skills are automatically created, tested, refined, and pruned as the policy improves, enabling reconciled skill-policy co-evolution.
idea_ch: 一种强化学习循环内的技能创建框架，利用GRPO的群组结构嵌入断言驱动的技能创建、组内轨迹采样和带自适应折扣的汤普森采样进行技能版本选择。
一种断言驱动的技能创建器，能从历史经验中诊断失败原因并提出基于条件触发的技能修订方案，用于LLM代理。
一种组内轨迹采样机制，在策略优化过程中实现不同技能版本的受控对比，捕获最能支持当前策略学习的版本。
一种带自适应折扣的汤普森采样方法，随策略进化动态平衡技能版本选择的探索与利用。
一种技能生命周期管理系统，技能随策略改进自动经历创建、测试、精炼和剪枝，实现技能与策略的协同进化。

title: MobEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolving Heuristic System for Interpretable Human Mobility Generation
summary: Human mobility generation aims to synthesize realistic trip chains for target populations based on individual features. Existing paradigms, including deep generative models, LLM-based methods, and traditional heuristics, struggle to satisfy the complex demands of this task while simultaneously maintaining interpretability, behavioral plausibility, population-level distributional alignment, and inference efficiency. To bridge this gap, we introduce MobEvolve, the first agentic self-evolving heuristic framework for human mobility generation. MobEvolve initializes a behavior-inspired heuristic system and employs an LLM agent to iteratively evolve its internal logic. By diagnosing empirical misalignments and failure cases on a validation set, the agent proposes targeted updates and accumulates evolution memory for cumulative self-improvement. Extensive evaluations on the Singapore and Montreal benchmarks demonstrate that MobEvolve significantly outperforms state-of-the-art deep generative and LLM-based methods in individual trajectory fidelity, population-level distribution alignment, and behavioral plausibility, while preserving interpretability and high inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: MobEvolve是一个首个智能体自进化启发式框架，用于人类移动性生成。它初始化行为启发的启发式系统，通过LLM代理迭代进化内部逻辑，诊断验证集上的经验错位和失败案例，累积进化记忆实现自我改进。在新加坡和蒙特利尔基准测试中，该方法在个体轨迹保真度、群体分布对齐和行为合理性方面显著优于现有深度生成模型和LLM方法，同时保持可解释性和高推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类移动性生成方法（深度生成模型、LLM方法和传统启发式方法）难以同时满足可解释性、行为合理性、群体级分布对齐和推理效率等复杂需求。
AI.method: 提出MobEvolve框架：1) 初始化行为启发的启发式系统；2) 使用LLM代理在验证集上诊断经验错位和失败案例；3) LLM代理提出针对性更新并累积进化记忆；4) 迭代自改进实现启发式逻辑的持续演化。
AI.result: 在新加坡和蒙特利尔基准测试中，MobEvolve在个体轨迹保真度、群体分布对齐和行为合理性方面显著优于SOTA深度生成模型和LLM方法，同时保持可解释性和高推理效率。
AI.conclusion: MobEvolve首次展示了智能体自进化启发式框架在人类移动性生成中的有效性，成功弥合了可解释性、行为合理性、分布对齐和效率之间的鸿沟。
idea_en: An agentic self-evolving heuristic framework (MobEvolve) for human mobility generation that iteratively evolves its internal logic through an LLM agent diagnosing empirical misalignments on a validation set.
A behavior-inspired heuristic system initialization method that serves as the foundation for self-improving mobility generation.
An LLM-agent-driven evolution mechanism that proposes targeted updates to heuristic rules based on failure case analysis and accumulates evolution memory for cumulative self-improvement.
A validation-set-based diagnostic approach that identifies empirical misalignments and failure cases in generated mobility patterns to guide heuristic evolution.
An evolution memory accumulation method that enables cumulative self-improvement of heuristic systems across multiple iteration cycles.
idea_ch: 一种基于智能体自进化启发式框架（MobEvolve）的人类移动性生成方法，通过LLM代理诊断验证集上的经验错位来迭代进化其内部逻辑
一种行为启发的启发式系统初始化方法，作为自我改进移动性生成的基础
一种LLM代理驱动的进化机制，基于失败案例分析提出启发式规则的目标更新，并累积进化记忆以实现持续自我改进
一种基于验证集的诊断方法，识别生成移动模式中的经验错位和失败案例，以引导启发式进化
一种进化记忆累积方法，使启发式系统能够在多个迭代周期中实现累积性自我改进

title: Characterization of Multi-Model Agentic AI Systems on General Tasks via Trace-Driven Simulation
summary: Agentic AI completes tasks through iterative planning, tool use, and reasoning based on observed outcomes. Despite its popularity, its system-level behavior remains poorly understood, particularly for complex datasets and agent architectures-owing to highly non-deterministic execution, prohibitive evaluation costs, and limited visibility into proprietary models. This paper presents GAIATrace, the first token-level trace dataset of two state-of-the-art agentic systems (MiroThinker and OWL) running GAIA, a benchmark composed of a heterogeneous mix of general-purpose tasks. Unlike prior trace datasets, GAIATrace captures full reasoning tokens, task-level structures, and activities of every major participating LLMs, enabling in-depth systems research. Complementing the dataset, we present Vidur-Agent, a trace-driven simulator that can replay GAIATrace to perform reproducible, low-cost system evaluation across diverse simulated environments. Using both artifacts, we characterize how modern agentic systems handle general tasks and how various system design choices shape their behavior, yielding several unique findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GAIATrace，首个捕获智能体AI系统完整推理token级轨迹的数据集，并配套了Vidur-Agent轨迹驱动模拟器，用于低成本、可复现的系统级评估，揭示了现代智能体系统在通用任务上的行为特征。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体AI系统（如MiroThinker和OWL）在实际运行中具有高度非确定性、评估成本高昂且对专有模型可见性有限，其系统级行为在复杂数据集和架构下缺乏理解，现有数据集缺乏细粒度的token级轨迹信息。
AI.method: 构建GAIATrace数据集，捕获两个SOTA智能体系统（MiroThinker和OWL）在GAIA基准上的完整推理token、任务级结构和主要参与LLM的活动；开发Vidur-Agent模拟器，基于轨迹复现进行可复现、低成本的系统评估。
AI.result: 生成了首个token级智能体轨迹数据集，并通过模拟器实现了可复现的系统评估，表征了现代智能体系统处理通用任务的方式以及不同系统设计选择对行为的影响，得到多项独特发现。
AI.conclusion: GAIATrace和Vidur-Agent为智能体AI系统的系统级研究提供了关键基础设施，揭示了系统设计对智能体行为的影响，支持低成本可复现评估。
idea_en: A token-level trace dataset capturing full reasoning tokens, task-level structures, and activities of all major participating LLMs in agentic AI systems.
A trace-driven simulator (Vidur-Agent) that replays token-level traces for reproducible, low-cost system evaluation across diverse simulated environments.
Method to characterize how modern agentic systems handle general tasks and how system design choices shape their behavior using trace data and simulation.
idea_ch: 一种捕获智能体AI系统完整推理token、任务级结构和所有主要参与LLM活动的token级轨迹数据集构建方法。
一种基于轨迹驱动的模拟器，通过复现token级轨迹实现跨多样化模拟环境的可复现、低成本系统评估。
一种利用轨迹数据和模拟来表征现代智能体系统处理通用任务行为及系统设计选择影响的方法。

title: Evidence-Gated LLM Priors for Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as heuristic advisors for black-box optimization, yet their suggestions and self-reported confidence are not necessarily calibrated to downstream objective values. This issue becomes more pronounced in multi-objective Bayesian optimization, where different objectives may require different expert knowledge and where an LLM expert can be useful for one objective but misleading for another.
  We study how to use LLM-generated expert priors in discrete multi-objective Bayesian optimization without blindly trusting them. We propose an objective-wise reputation-market mechanism that treats each expert-objective pair as a falsifiable prior source. Expert weights are updated online from observed objective feedback, discounted over time, and gated by market-level trust. We then introduce a decoupled counterfactual gate that can use the LLM prior without confidence, use it with confidence, or abstain from the LLM prior entirely.
  Across controlled synthetic stress tests and three molecule optimization benchmarks with \qwenflash{}-generated expert priors, we find that dynamic objective-wise calibration improves robustness over fixed LLM priors. However, raw LLM confidence is not reliably beneficial: on ESOL, confidence is positively correlated with prediction error; on FreeSolv, confidence can help; and on Lipophilicity, ignoring confidence remains strongest. Our fixed three-arm counterfactual gate improves over the first counterfactual variant on ESOL and FreeSolv, while an attempted margin portfolio exposes a useful negative result: margin selection should be acquisition-aware rather than based only on one-step prior error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种目标维度的声誉-市场机制，用于在离散多目标贝叶斯优化中动态校准LLM生成的专业先验，避免盲目信任LLM建议。通过带折扣的目标维度加权、市场级信任门控以及解耦反事实门控机制，实现LLM先验的自适应使用。实验表明，动态目标维度校准比固定LLM先验更鲁棒，但原始LLM置信度并非总是有益。
AI.motivation: LLM作为黑箱优化的启发式顾问时，其建议和自信度与下游目标值校准不佳，尤其在多目标贝叶斯优化中，不同目标可能需要不同专业知识，LLM专家对某些目标有用但对另一些可能误导。
AI.method: 提出目标维度的声誉-市场机制：将每个专家-目标对视为可证伪的先验来源，根据观测到的目标反馈在线更新专家权重，权重随时间折扣，并由市场级信任门控。引入解耦反事实门控，可无置信度使用LLM先验、带置信度使用或完全弃用LLM先验。
AI.result: 在合成压力测试和三个分子优化基准上，动态目标维度校准比固定LLM先验更鲁棒。但原始LLM置信度不可靠：ESOL上置信度与预测误差正相关，FreeSolv上置信度有帮助，Lipophilicity上忽略置信度最强。固定三臂反事实门控优于变体，但边距组合实验表明边距选择应基于采集意识而非一步先验误差。
AI.conclusion: 动态目标维度校准比固定LLM先验更鲁棒，但LLM置信度的效用是任务依赖的，需要根据具体目标自适应处理。
idea_en: Objective-wise reputation-market mechanism for dynamic calibration of LLM expert priors in multi-objective Bayesian optimization
Decoupled counterfactual gate that can use LLM prior without confidence, with confidence, or abstain entirely
Online expert weight update from observed objective feedback with time discounting and market-level trust gating
idea_ch: 多目标贝叶斯优化中基于目标维度声誉-市场机制的LLM专家先验动态校准方法
解耦反事实门控机制：支持无置信度、带置信度或完全弃用LLM先验的三臂切换策略
基于观测反馈的在线专家权重更新机制，结合时间折扣和市场级信任门控

title: TrafficRAG: A Multimodal RAG Framework for Traffic Accident Liability Determination
summary: Traffic accident liability analysis is a critical yet challenging task in intelligent transportation and legal assistance. Existing methods often suffer from low efficiency, subjective judgment, and inconsistent analysis results. Meanwhile, large language models are constrained by noisy video inputs and insufficient legal domain knowledge. To address these issues, this work presents TrafficRAG, a multimodal retrieval-augmented framework for automated traffic accident analysis and report generation. Specifically, the proposed framework first adopts a vision-language model to produce structured textual descriptions of accident scenarios, which serve as accurate retrieval queries. Based on these textual queries, a hybrid retrieval strategy integrating BM25 sparse retrieval and dense embedding retrieval is employed to fetch relevant traffic regulations and similar historical cases. Finally, the large language model incorporates retrieved legal knowledge and multimodal accident evidence for comprehensive reasoning, and generates standardized, legally grounded liability analysis reports. Extensive experiments show that TrafficRAG consistently outperforms baseline methods, achieving 77.32% Legal Norm Adaptation Accuracy, 81.71% Factual Faithfulness, and a Liability Ratio MAE of 5.48%. The results validate that integrating multimodal factual evidence with legal clauses via retrieval augmentation can effectively improve the reliability and accuracy of traffic accident liability determination.

AI.tldr: 提出TrafficRAG，一种多模态检索增强框架，用于自动化交通事故责任分析与报告生成，通过视觉-语言模型提取结构化描述、混合检索相关法规和案例，结合大语言模型生成合规责任分析报告。
AI.motivation: 现有交通事故责任分析方法效率低、主观性强、结果不一致；大语言模型受限于噪声视频输入和缺乏法律领域知识。
AI.method: 1) 视觉-语言模型生成事故场景的结构化文本描述；2) 混合检索策略（BM25稀疏检索+稠密嵌入检索）获取相关交通法规和历史案例；3) 大语言模型融合检索到的法律知识与多模态事故证据进行推理，生成标准化责任分析报告。
AI.result: Legal Norm Adaptation Accuracy 77.32%，Factual Faithfulness 81.71%，Liability Ratio MAE 5.48%，优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过检索增强将多模态事实证据与法律条款相结合，可有效提高交通事故责任判定的可靠性和准确性。
idea_en: Hybrid retrieval strategy combining BM25 sparse retrieval and dense embedding retrieval for fetching traffic regulations and historical cases
Vision-language model for generating structured textual descriptions of accident scenarios as accurate retrieval queries
Multimodal retrieval-augmented framework (TrafficRAG) integrating visual evidence with legal clause retrieval for automated liability analysis
Standardized, legally grounded liability analysis report generation using LLM with retrieved legal knowledge and multimodal accident evidence
idea_ch: 结合BM25稀疏检索与稠密嵌入检索的混合检索策略，用于获取交通法规和历史案例
利用视觉-语言模型生成事故场景结构化文本描述，作为精确检索查询
TrafficRAG多模态检索增强框架，将视觉证据与法律条款检索相结合用于自动化责任分析
基于大语言模型融合检索法律知识与多模态事故证据，生成标准化、合规的责任分析报告

title: TriAlign: Towards Universal Truth Consistency in Personalized LLM Alignment
summary: Personalized large language models adapt responses to users' preferences and social attributes, but can introduce substantial universal truth inconsistencies across social groups, where some groups systematically receive less accurate responses on objective tasks. Existing alignment methods either ignore personalization or mainly focus on subjective preference alignment, largely overlooking fairness and consistency in universal truths. To address this gap, we study Truth-Invariant Alignment (TIA), an alignment problem for personalized LLMs that aims to ensure universal truths remain consistent across social groups while preserving personalization. We propose TriAlign, the first offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for TIA, where each social group is modeled as an agent interacting. TriAlign jointly optimizes universal truth accuracy, cross-group truth consistency, and personalization through a fairness-aware objective and an explicit inconsistency penalty. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that TriAlign achieves a stronger balance among these three objectives than strong baselines, reducing universal truth disparities across social groups while improving both objective task performance and personalization quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TriAlign框架，采用多智能体强化学习解决个性化大语言模型中普遍真理在不同社会群体间保持一致性的对齐问题，在保持个性化的同时减少真理不一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化大语言模型可能导致不同社会群体在客观任务上获得不一致的准确性，而现有对齐方法要么忽略个性化，要么主要关注主观偏好对齐，忽视了普遍真理的公平性和一致性。
AI.method: 提出TriAlign，首个用于真理不变性对齐的离线多智能体强化学习框架。将每个社会群体建模为一个智能体，通过公平性感知目标和显式不一致性惩罚，联合优化普遍真理准确性、跨群体真理一致性和个性化三个目标。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，TriAlign相比强基线方法在三个目标之间实现了更好的平衡，减少了跨社会群体的普遍真理差异，同时提升了客观任务性能和个性化质量。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体强化学习框架能有效解决个性化LLM中普遍真理的跨群体一致性问题，实现公平性与个性化的兼得。
idea_en: A multi-agent reinforcement learning framework (TriAlign) for truth-invariant alignment in personalized LLMs, where each social group is modeled as an independent agent.
A fairness-aware objective function that jointly optimizes universal truth accuracy, cross-group truth consistency, and personalization quality.
An explicit inconsistency penalty mechanism that penalizes disparities in universal truth accuracy across different social groups.
An offline MARL training method for personalized LLM alignment that does not require online interaction with users.
idea_ch: TriAlign框架：将每个社会群体建模为独立智能体的多智能体强化学习框架，用于个性化大语言模型的真理不变性对齐
公平性感知目标函数：联合优化普遍真理准确性、跨群体真理一致性和个性化质量的创新目标设计
显式不一致性惩罚机制：对跨社会群体间普遍真理准确率差异进行显式惩罚的技术方案
离线多智能体强化学习训练方法：无需在线交互即可实现个性化LLM对齐的离线训练方法

title: EvoBrain: Continual Learning of EEG Foundation Models Across Heterogeneous BCI Tasks
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is the cornerstone of non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), yet conventional decoding relies on fragmented, task-specific architectures that severely limit cross-task scalability. While EEG foundation models pre-trained on massive corpora promise universal brain decoding, current post-training depends on task-isolated fine-tuning. This static paradigm restricts knowledge transfer across heterogeneous tasks, hinders model scalability, and incurs computational and storage overheads that scale linearly with task count. To overcome these bottlenecks, we formulate downstream adaptation as a cross-task continual learning problem and propose EvoBrain, a dynamic, task-aware continual learning framework for unified EEG decoding. EvoBrain addresses the plasticity-stability trade-off via two complementary components: (1) Neuro-Spectral Task Normalization (NSN) aligns incoming tasks with historical statistics while recalibrating spectral responses to handle distributional and neuro-spectral shifts; and (2) Response-Affinity Distillation (RAD), combined with time-dependent replay, preserves old-task response geometry and promotes selective knowledge transfer between spectrally compatible tasks, effectively mitigating forgetting. Extensive evaluations across six distinct BCI tasks demonstrate that EvoBrain consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods across diverse foundation backbones, optimally balancing plasticity and stability. To our knowledge, this work pioneers cross-task continual learning in the EEG domain, advancing the realization of a unified, one-for-all brain decoding system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoBrain，一种动态、任务感知的持续学习框架，用于统一脑电信号解码，通过神经频谱任务归一化（NSN）和响应亲和力蒸馏（RAD）解决了跨任务持续学习中的可塑性-稳定性权衡问题，在六个BCI任务中超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统EEG解码依赖于碎片化、任务特定的架构，严重限制了跨任务可扩展性；现有EEG基础模型的后训练采用任务隔离的微调方式，限制了知识迁移、阻碍模型可扩展性，且计算和存储开销随任务数量线性增长。
AI.method: EvoBrain框架包含两个互补组件：(1) 神经频谱任务归一化（NSN），将新任务与历史统计信息对齐并重新校准频谱响应以处理分布和频谱偏移；(2) 响应亲和力蒸馏（RAD），结合时间依赖性回放，保留旧任务响应几何结构并促进频谱兼容任务间的选择性知识迁移，有效缓解遗忘。
AI.result: 在六个不同的BCI任务上的广泛评估表明，EvoBrain在多种基础骨干网络上持续超越现有最先进方法，最优地平衡了可塑性与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作首次在EEG领域开创了跨任务持续学习，推动了统一、一对多的大脑解码系统的实现。
idea_en: Neuro-Spectral Task Normalization (NSN) mechanism that aligns incoming EEG tasks with historical statistical distributions while recalibrating spectral responses to handle distributional and neuro-spectral shifts in cross-task continual learning.

Response-Affinity Distillation (RAD) method combined with time-dependent replay that preserves old-task response geometry and promotes selective knowledge transfer between spectrally compatible EEG tasks.
A task-aware continual learning framework (EvoBrain) for unified EEG decoding that addresses the plasticity-stability trade-off via complementary normalization and distillation components.
Cross-task continual learning paradigm applied to EEG foundation models, enabling knowledge transfer across heterogeneous BCI tasks without task-isolated fine-tuning.
Unified one-for-all brain decoding system architecture that dynamically adapts to new EEG tasks while retaining performance on previously learned tasks.
idea_ch: 神经频谱任务归一化（NSN）机制：将新输入的EEG任务与历史统计分布对齐，同时重新校准频谱响应，以处理跨任务持续学习中的分布偏移和神经频谱偏移。
响应亲和力蒸馏（RAD）方法：结合时间依赖性回放，保留旧任务的响应几何结构，促进频谱兼容的EEG任务间的选择性知识迁移，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
EvoBrain任务感知持续学习框架：通过互补的归一化和蒸馏组件解决EEG解码中的可塑性-稳定性权衡，实现统一的脑电信号解码。
跨任务持续学习范式应用于EEG基础模型：使知识能够在异构BCI任务间迁移，无需任务隔离的微调，大幅降低计算和存储开销。
统一的一对多脑解码系统架构：动态适应新EEG任务的同时保持对已学习任务的性能，为通用脑机接口系统奠定基础。

title: Structure-Guided Adaptive Propagation for Protein-Protein Interaction Site Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interaction sites (PPIS) is essential for understanding cellular processes, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic target discovery. Graph-based deep learning has advanced PPIS prediction by incorporating residue-level structural context. However, most graph-based models still rely on fixed propagation schemes that treat all residues similarly, despite the structural and functional heterogeneity of protein interfaces. Such propagation may limit the ability to adapt information diffusion to local geometric environments, making it difficult to distinguish true interaction sites from structurally similar non-interacting neighbors. We present SGAP-PPIS, a structure-guided adaptive propagation model for PPIS prediction. Rather than using a fixed propagation mechanism, SGAP-PPIS leverages multi-scale geometric states from an equivariant graph neural network to generate residue-wise propagation coefficients. This design allows each residue to adaptively balance local feature preservation and neighborhood diffusion according to its geometric microenvironment. Experimental results show that SGAP-PPIS achieves competitive performance among the state-of-the-art methods on Test\_60. Ablation studies show that geometry-conditioned adaptive propagation, scale-aligned geometric guidance, and multi-step propagation-state representation jointly drive these improvements.

AI.tldr: SGAP-PPIS提出了一种结构引导的自适应传播模型用于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用位点预测，通过等变图神经网络生成残基级别的传播系数，使每个残基能根据局部几何微环境自适应平衡特征保留与邻域扩散，在Test_60上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的PPIS预测模型使用固定传播方案，对所有残基一视同仁，无法适应蛋白质界面结构和功能的异质性，难以区分真正的相互作用位点与结构相似的非相互作用邻居。
AI.method: 利用等变图神经网络提取多尺度几何状态，为每个残基生成自适应的传播系数，使信息扩散过程依赖于局部几何微环境，实现自适应平衡局部特征保留与邻域扩散。
AI.result: 在Test_60数据集上达到与最先进方法竞争的性能，消融实验验证了几何条件自适应传播、尺度对齐几何引导、多步传播状态表示三方面共同驱动性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 自适应传播机制能够有效区分真实相互作用位点与结构相似的非相互作用邻居，为基于结构的蛋白质相互作用预测提供了新范式。
idea_en: A structure-guided adaptive propagation method for protein-protein interaction site prediction that generates residue-wise propagation coefficients based on multi-scale geometric states from an equivariant graph neural network.

A geometry-conditioned adaptive propagation mechanism that allows each residue to dynamically balance local feature preservation and neighborhood diffusion according to its geometric microenvironment.
A scale-aligned geometric guidance technique that integrates multi-scale geometric information to modulate information propagation on protein residue graphs.
A multi-step propagation-state representation method that captures evolving geometric contexts during iterative message passing for improved interaction site discrimination.
idea_ch: 一种基于结构引导的自适应传播方法，利用等变图神经网络提取的多尺度几何状态为每个残基生成传播系数，用于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用位点预测。
一种几何条件自适应的传播机制，使每个残基根据其局部几何微环境动态平衡特征保留与邻域扩散。
一种尺度对齐的几何引导技术，整合多尺度几何信息来调控蛋白质残基图上的信息传播过程。
一种多步传播状态表示方法，在迭代消息传递过程中捕获不断演化的几何上下文，提升相互作用位点的判别能力。

title: Stochastic convergence of parallel asynchronous adaptive first-order methods
summary: A new class of asynchronous adaptive first-order optimization methods is introduced, comprising asynchronous variants of several popular algorithms. Versions of these methods using momentum and/or inexact normalization are also considered. The convergence of methods in the class on non-convex functions is analyzed in a fully stochastic setting, and is shown to be (up to logarithmic factors) of order O(1/sqrt{t}) under reasonable assumptions. Numerical experiments suggest that such asynchronous adaptive algorithms are very relevant in heterogeneous large-scale machine learning systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一类新的异步自适应一阶优化方法，包含多种流行算法的异步变体，在非凸函数上实现了O(1/√t)的收敛速度，适用于异构大规模机器学习系统。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应优化方法（如Adam）在同步设置下表现良好，但在异构大规模分布式系统中，由于节点计算速度差异导致的同步瓶颈严重拖慢训练效率。需要设计能够适应异步并行环境、无需同步等待的优化算法。
AI.method: 1. 设计了一类异步自适应一阶优化方法框架，包含多种流行算法（如Adam、RMSProp）的异步变体；2. 支持动量项和/或非精确归一化（inexact normalization）；3. 在全随机设置下进行非凸函数的收敛性分析；4. 通过数值实验验证算法在异构大规模机器学习系统中的有效性。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在合理假设下，该类算法的收敛速度达到O(1/√t)（除去对数因子）；数值实验表明异步自适应算法在异构大规模机器学习系统中具有很高的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 提出的异步自适应一阶优化方法类在非凸随机优化场景下具有良好的理论收敛保证和实际性能，为异构大规模分布式机器学习系统提供了有效的优化工具。
idea_en: Asynchronous adaptive first-order optimization method family: A framework that transforms synchronous adaptive optimizers (e.g., Adam, RMSProp) into asynchronous variants with theoretical convergence guarantees.
Inexact normalization mechanism for asynchronous optimization: A normalization technique that works with delayed/stale gradients in asynchronous settings while maintaining convergence properties.
Momentum-enabled asynchronous adaptive optimizer: Integration of momentum terms into asynchronous adaptive optimization methods with proven O(1/sqrt{t}) convergence on non-convex functions.
Asynchronous optimizer with logarithmic-factor convergence bound: An optimization method that achieves O(1/sqrt{t}) convergence (up to logarithmic factors) under fully stochastic non-convex settings.
idea_ch: 异步自适应一阶优化方法框架：将同步自适应优化器（如Adam、RMSProp）转换为异步变体的通用框架，并附带理论收敛保证。
非精确归一化异步优化机制：一种在异步设置中处理延迟/过时梯度的归一化技术，同时保持收敛性质。
带动量的异步自适应优化器：将动量项集成到异步自适应优化方法中，在非凸函数上证明O(1/√t)收敛速度。
对数因子收敛界的异步优化器：在全随机非凸设置下达到O(1/√t)收敛速度（除去对数因子）的优化方法。

title: Consistency evaluation of benchmarks used for causal discovery
summary: In graphical causal model, causal discovery aims to construct a causal graph based on numerical data and domain knowledge in plain text. However, the evaluation of causal discovery methods remains a challenge in the area as the progress of domain researches often makes benchmark causal graphs contain mis-aligned knowledge. This problem especially affects the evaluation of large language model (LLM) based causal discovery methods as they are sensitive to the new discoveries in the literature. This work is the first to systematically study the quality of benchmark causal graphs. Specifically, we design a pipeline that automatically retrieves relevant research papers from scientific databases, and prompts LLMs to check the consistency between the benchmark causal graphs and domain research papers. We evaluate 11 popular real-world benchmarks, for which our pipeline in total proceeds 38,081 domain papers. Our results show that popular benchmarks vary significantly in their consistency with domain research, with clear implications for causal discovery research.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了因果发现基准因果图的质量问题，设计了一个自动化管道，通过检索科学数据库中的相关研究论文并利用LLM检查基准因果图与领域论文之间的一致性，对11个流行真实世界基准进行评估，总计处理38,081篇领域论文，发现不同基准与领域研究的一致性差异显著。
AI.motivation: 因果发现方法的评估面临挑战，因为领域研究的进展常使基准因果图包含不一致的知识，尤其影响基于LLM的因果发现方法的评估效果。
AI.method: 设计了一个自动化管道：从科学数据库检索相关研究论文，利用LLM检查基准因果图与领域研究论文之间的一致性，并对11个流行真实世界基准进行评估。
AI.result: 对11个流行真实世界基准进行了评估，总计处理38,081篇领域论文，发现不同基准因果图与领域研究的一致性存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 基准因果图的质量对因果发现研究有显著影响，不同基准的一致性差异明显，这对因果发现方法的评估具有重要启示。
idea_en: A pipeline system that automatically retrieves domain research papers from scientific databases and uses LLMs to check consistency between benchmark causal graphs and domain literature.
A method for systematically evaluating the quality of benchmark causal graphs in causal discovery by leveraging LLM-based consistency checking with scientific literature.
An automated benchmark validation framework that identifies mis-aligned knowledge in causal graphs by cross-referencing with dynamically retrieved domain papers.
idea_ch: 一种自动从科学数据库检索领域研究论文并利用LLM检查基准因果图与领域文献一致性的管道系统
一种通过利用LLM与科学文献进行一致性检查来系统评估因果发现中基准因果图质量的方法
一种通过交叉引用动态检索的领域论文来识别因果图中不一致知识的自动化基准验证框架

title: OctoT2I: A Self-Evolving Agentic Text-to-Image Router
summary: The explosive growth of Text-to-Image (T2I) models, from large-scale versions to lightweight, real-time ones, now faces diminishing marginal returns from single-model scaling. Agentic T2I methods emerged to alleviate this bottleneck by using multiple models. However, existing agentic T2I methods suffer from three key challenges: reliance on expensive handcrafted priors or human annotations, rigid single-path decision mechanisms, and a neglect of inference efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce OctoT2I, a novel agentic framework that reformulates the T2I task as a joint optimization of generation quality and inference efficiency. OctoT2I implements a stateful, multi-round routing strategy that adaptively selects the most suitable tool based on its knowledge and memory. This strategy is enabled by a knowledge base built from scratch by our novel Self-Evolving Mechanism. This mechanism, which requires no human supervision, first autonomously defines foundational Conceptual Dimensions (eg, style, color, count) and then intelligently explores their combinations via an iterative" Propose--Solve--Evaluate--Learn"(PSEL) loop. The PSEL loop efficiently discovers each tool's capability frontier, driving continuous improvement without external guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OctoT2I achieves competitive performance (0.96) on GenEval while delivering a 90.3% inference speedup and a 56.6% energy-efficiency gain over the leading baseline (Flow-GRPO), striking an exceptional balance between performance and efficiency. Code and models will be made available.

AI.tldr: OctoT2I是一个新型智能体T2I框架，通过自演化机制和状态化多轮路由策略，在无人工标注条件下实现生成质量与推理效率的联合优化，性能与GenEval基准相当（0.96），同时实现90.3%推理加速和56.6%能效提升。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型面临单模型规模扩展的边际收益递减问题，而现有智能体T2I方法存在三大挑战：依赖昂贵的手工先验或人工标注、刚性的单路径决策机制、忽视推理效率。
AI.method: 提出OctoT2I框架，将T2I任务重构为生成质量与推理效率的联合优化问题。核心创新包括：(1) 状态化多轮路由策略，基于知识库和记忆自适应选择最佳工具；(2) 自演化机制(Self-Evolving Mechanism)，通过"提议-解决-评估-学习"(PSEL)循环，从零自主构建概念维度知识库并探索其组合，发现每个工具的能力边界。
AI.result: 在GenEval上达到0.96的竞争性能，相比Flow-GRPO实现90.3%推理加速和56.6%能效提升，在性能与效率之间达到卓越平衡。
AI.conclusion: OctoT2I通过自演化、无监督的知识构建和自适应路由，有效解决了智能体T2I方法的核心痛点，展示了在性能不降前提下大幅提升推理效率的可行路径。
idea_en: A self-evolving mechanism for autonomously constructing a knowledge base of conceptual dimensions (e.g., style, color, count) without human supervision, using a Propose-Solve-Evaluate-Learn (PSEL) iterative loop to discover tool capability frontiers.

A stateful multi-round routing strategy for agentic text-to-image tasks that adaptively selects the most suitable tool based on accumulated knowledge and memory, enabling joint optimization of generation quality and inference efficiency.

A method for reformulating Text-to-Image generation as a joint optimization problem balancing generation quality and inference efficiency, solved via an agentic framework with adaptive tool selection.
idea_ch: 一种自演化机制，通过'提议-解决-评估-学习'(PSEL)迭代循环，在无需人工监督的情况下自主构建包含风格、颜色、数量等概念维度的知识库，并智能探索其组合以发现每个工具的能力边界。
一种状态化多轮路由策略，基于累积知识和记忆自适应选择最适合的T2I工具，实现对生成质量和推理效率的联合优化。
一种将文生图任务重构为生成质量与推理效率联合优化问题的方法，通过智能体框架实现自适应工具选择以平衡性能与效率。

title: Token Predictors Are Not Planners: Building Physically Grounded Causal Reasoners
summary: Current benchmarks for embodied vision-language planning often favor linguistic next-token prediction over physically grounded next-state reasoning. This rewards models that mimic statistical language priors rather than track causal dependencies, reducing physical planning to shallow sequence modeling. We argue that reliable physical autonomy requires a shift from linguistically grounded token prediction toward physically grounded causal reasoning. To this end, we introduce Causal-Plan-Bench, a high-fidelity diagnostic suite curated through multi-stage verification to evaluate embodied planning across four causal dimensions. We also construct Causal-Plan-1M, a million-scale corpus of explicit reasoning traces produced by a four-stage annotation pipeline over egocentric videos. Extensive evaluation shows that leading models still struggle to demonstrate genuine physical agency, with Gemini 3 Pro reaching only 38.18 on our benchmark. In contrast, our training recipe enables Causal Planner, built on Qwen3-VL-8B, to internalize physical logic for more accurate next-state estimation. The model achieves strong in-domain performance and cross-benchmark generalization, and reveals a Causal Scaling Law: scaling causal training data to one million instances yields a 36.3% relative gain, from 33.22 to 45.28. Overall, our work provides a concrete step toward turning agents from superficial token predictors into physically grounded causal reasoners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Causal-Plan-Bench基准和Causal-Plan-1M数据集，推动具身视觉语言规划从浅层词元预测转向物理因果推理，并揭示了因果缩放定律。
AI.motivation: 现有具身视觉语言规划基准偏向语言下一个词元预测，而非物理状态推理，导致模型模仿统计语言先验而非跟踪因果依赖，缺乏真正的物理自主性。
AI.method: 构建Causal-Plan-Bench高保真诊断套件（多阶段验证，覆盖四个因果维度）；构建Causal-Plan-1M百万级推理轨迹数据集（四阶段标注流水线）；提出Causal Planner训练方案（基于Qwen3-VL-8B）。
AI.result: Gemini 3 Pro仅得38.18分；Causal Planner达到45.28分；因果缩放定律显示百万级数据带来36.3%相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 从词元预测转向因果推理是具身智能的关键，因果缩放定律为未来训练提供指导。
idea_en: A multi-stage verification pipeline for constructing high-fidelity embodied planning benchmarks that evaluate causal reasoning across multiple causal dimensions.
A four-stage annotation pipeline over egocentric videos to produce million-scale explicit reasoning traces for causal physical planning.
A training recipe enabling vision-language models to internalize physical logic for more accurate next-state estimation rather than superficial token prediction.
The discovery of a Causal Scaling Law showing that scaling causal training data yields predictable relative gains in physical reasoning performance.
A diagnostic framework that distinguishes linguistic next-token prediction capability from genuine physical next-state causal reasoning in embodied agents.
idea_ch: 一种多阶段验证流水线，用于构建高保真实体规划基准，可在多个因果维度上评估因果推理能力
一种基于自我中心视频的四阶段标注流水线，用于生成百万级显式因果推理轨迹数据集
一种训练策略，使视觉语言模型内化物理逻辑，实现更准确的下一状态估计，而非浅层词元预测
因果缩放定律的发现：因果训练数据的规模化能带来物理推理性能的可预测相对增益
一种诊断框架，用于区分具身代理的浅层语言词元预测能力与真正的物理状态因果推理能力

title: CAPF: Guiding Search-Agent Rollouts with Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback
summary: Recent LLM search agents use reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to learn search-augmented reasoning from outcome rewards. On hard problems, these agents rarely sample end-to-end successful rollouts, leaving outcome-only RLVR with few positive-reward trajectories. We argue that improving learning on such problems requires additional guidance during training, and RLVR already contains verifier-side information that can provide it. This information can identify errors or omissions in the agent's submitted answer and guide revision within the rollout. We propose a training-time mechanism called \textbf{Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback} (CAPF), which makes this verifier-side information available through a Privileged Feedback call during training. CAPF lets the policy revise zero-reward attempts into positive-reward repair trajectories and attenuates credit for the feedback call and earlier actions to accommodate deployment without this call. Empirical research demonstrates that CAPF improves Qwen3-4B's average exact-match score from 44.7% under outcome-only RLVR to 48.5% on seven open-domain QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAPF方法，在训练时利用验证器侧信息为LLM搜索智能体提供特权反馈，将零奖励轨迹修复为正奖励轨迹，并衰减反馈调用信用以适应部署时无调用的场景，在7个开放域QA基准上将准确率从44.7%提升至48.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在硬问题上难以采样到端到端成功的轨迹，导致正奖励样本稀少，限制了学习效果。
AI.method: 提出Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback（CAPF），在训练时通过特权反馈调用向策略提供验证器侧信息（指出答案中的错误或遗漏），引导策略进行修订，并衰减反馈调用及之前动作的信用权重，以匹配部署时无反馈调用的场景。
AI.result: 在7个开放域QA基准上，Qwen3-4B的平均精确匹配得分从纯结果RLVR的44.7%提升至48.5%。
AI.conclusion: 验证器侧信息可有效改善强化学习中正样本稀疏问题，CAPF通过训练时提供特权反馈并衰减信用，显著提升了搜索增强推理性能。
idea_en: A training-time mechanism (CAPF) that provides Privileged Feedback from the verifier to guide the policy in revising zero-reward trajectories into positive-reward trajectories during RLVR training.

A credit attenuation technique that down-weights the Privileged Feedback call and preceding actions during training, enabling the policy to operate effectively at deployment time without the feedback call.
Using verifier-side information (error/omission identification) as a training signal to repair failed search agent rollouts in reinforcement learning.
idea_ch: 一种训练时特权反馈机制（CAPF），在RLVR训练过程中，由验证器向策略提供特权反馈信息，引导策略将零奖励轨迹修订为正奖励轨迹。
一种信用衰减技术，在训练时降低特权反馈调用及之前动作的信用权重，使策略在部署时无需反馈调用即可有效运作。
利用验证器侧信息（识别答案中的错误或遗漏）作为训练信号，在强化学习中修复失败的搜索智能体轨迹。

title: Evaluation of Baseline Methods for IDD-based SSD External Memory Search
comment: accepted to The 19th International Symposium on Combinatorial Search (SoCS2026)
summary: Many difficult search problems cannot be solved by algorithms such as A* using only RAM. Search algorithms which use external memory such as SSDs and HDDs with much higher capacity than RAM have been proposed in previous work, but previous work has focused on delayed duplicate detection approaches, as well as complex immediate duplicate detection (IDD) methods, and relatively simple methods for IDD have not been systematically studied. In addition, the effect of OS-level mechanisms for managing and speeding up accesses to external memory, such as page caches, has not been studied. This paper addresses these gaps in the literature by evaluating and analyzing the performance of simple baseline approaches for IDD-based A*.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在外部内存（SSD/HDD）上进行A*搜索时，简单即时重复检测（IDD）方法的性能，以及操作系统级页面缓存机制的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有外部内存搜索算法主要集中在延迟重复检测和复杂的即时重复检测方法上，缺乏对简单IDD方法的系统研究，且未考虑操作系统页面缓存等机制的影响。
AI.method: 评估和分析基于IDD的A*算法的简单基线方法的性能，考虑操作系统级页面缓存等机制。
AI.result: 尚未在摘要中明确给出，但预期会展示简单IDD方法在外部内存搜索中的性能表现及页面缓存的影响。
AI.conclusion: 填补了外部内存搜索中简单IDD方法和操作系统缓存机制研究的空白。
idea_en: A simple Immediate Duplicate Detection (IDD) method for A* search algorithm that leverages OS-level page cache to accelerate external memory access on SSDs/HDDs
A hybrid external memory search architecture combining simple IDD with OS page cache management for efficient large-scale state space exploration
A performance evaluation framework for comparing simple IDD baselines against complex IDD and delayed duplicate detection approaches in external memory A* search
idea_ch: 一种利用操作系统级页面缓存加速SSD/HDD外部内存访问的A*搜索简单即时重复检测方法
结合简单即时重复检测与操作系统页面缓存管理的高效大规模状态空间探索混合外部内存搜索架构
用于比较简单IDD基线方法与复杂IDD及延迟重复检测方法在外部内存A*搜索中性能的评估框架

title: Does Compression Preserve Uncertainty? A Unified Benchmark for Quantized and Sparse LLMs via Conformal Prediction
summary: Model compression techniques such as quantization and pruning are widely used to reduce the deployment cost of large language models (LLMs), with existing evaluations focusing almost exclusively on accuracy preservation. However, in safety-critical applications, a model's ability to reliably quantify its own uncertainty is equally important. We ask: does compression preserve this ability? To answer this question, we benchmark 12 LLMs under various compression configurations across five NLP tasks, using conformal prediction to provide a rigorous, distribution-free measure of uncertainty. Our experiments reveal that: (I) compression frequently decouples accuracy from uncertainty; (II) larger models absorb compression-induced uncertainty far more effectively than smaller ones; and (III) uncertainty inflation is often threshold-like rather than gradual. These results suggest that accuracy-only evaluation is insufficient for assessing the deployment readiness of compressed LLMs, and that uncertainty-aware benchmarking should be a standard component of model compression pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了模型压缩（量化和剪枝）对大语言模型不确定性量化能力的影响，发现压缩会破坏模型校准不确定性（尤其阈值式膨胀），且准确性指标无法反映这一问题，需将不确定性评估纳入模型压缩标准流程。
AI.motivation: 现有模型压缩评估几乎只关注准确性保留，但在安全关键应用中，模型可靠量化自身不确定性的能力同样重要，而压缩是否破坏这一能力尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 对12种大语言模型在多种压缩配置下，跨5个NLP任务，采用共形预测（conformal prediction）提供严格、分布自由的 uncertainty 度量进行基准测试。
AI.result: （I）压缩经常使准确性与不确定性解耦；（II）大模型吸收压缩引发的不确定性远优于小模型；（III）不确定性膨胀往往是阈值式而非渐进式的。
AI.conclusion: 仅评估准确率不足以判断压缩后LLM的部署安全性，不确定性感知的基准测试应成为模型压缩管线的标准组成部分。
idea_en: A method for evaluating compressed language models using conformal prediction to generate rigorous, distribution-free uncertainty measures alongside accuracy metrics.
A system for detecting threshold-like uncertainty inflation in quantized or pruned LLMs, enabling early warning of degradation in uncertainty calibration.
A compression-aware uncertainty benchmarking pipeline that integrates conformal prediction as a standard component for safety-critical LLM deployment.
idea_ch: 一种基于共形预测（conformal prediction）的压缩大语言模型不确定性评估方法，在准确性指标之外提供严格、分布自由的不确定性度量。
一种用于检测量化或剪枝后大语言模型中阈值式不确定性膨胀的系统，可提前预警不确定性校准退化。
一种不确定性感知的模型压缩基准测试管线，将共形预测作为安全关键型LLM部署的标准评估组件。

title: WorldCoder-Bench: Benchmarking Physically Grounded 3D World Synthesis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked not only to write static interfaces, but to construct executable interactive worlds from natural language. Browser-native 3D, commonly built with Three.js, is a natural next frontier: generated programs must integrate assets, obey spatial and physical constraints, and keep user-facing controls synchronized with hidden runtime state. Existing web-generation benchmarks and evaluators, however, largely observe only pixels or DOM nodes, while the mechanics of a Three.js world unfold inside an opaque <canvas>. We introduce WorldCoder-Bench, a benchmark for autonomous, physically grounded 3D world synthesis. WorldCoder-Bench contains 2,026 expert-curated tasks across Simulation, Rendering, and Application scenarios, with optional .glb assets and hidden behavioral contracts. We further propose StateProbe, an execution-based protocol that probes generated programs in a sandboxed browser and verifies hidden, mutation-hardened contracts over runtime states and transitions. Beyond verification coverage, we report Return on Automation and Time Efficiency Multiplier to measure correctness-adjusted cost and time savings. Across nine frontier models, the best system reaches only 27.8% verification coverage on WorldCoder-Core and 19.9% on WorldCoder-Robust, with failures dominated by state-schema drift and broken interaction chains rather than missing scene elements. Utility metrics further show that cheap or fast models can still provide substantial value on easier domains. WorldCoder-Bench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WorldCoder-Bench/.

AI.tldr: 提出了WorldCoder-Bench基准测试和StateProbe协议，用于评估大语言模型从自然语言生成可执行的、物理约束的Three.js 3D世界的能力，发现当前最优模型仅达到27.8%的验证覆盖率，主要失败原因是状态模式漂移和交互链断裂。
AI.motivation: 现有的网页生成基准测试和评估工具仅观察像素或DOM节点，无法检测Three.js canvas内部隐藏的3D世界运行时状态和物理约束，缺乏对执行正确性的自动化评估手段。
AI.method: 构建包含2,026个专家策划任务的WorldCoder-Bench（覆盖仿真、渲染、应用场景），并设计StateProbe协议——在沙盒浏览器中探测生成程序，对隐藏的运行时状态和状态转换进行变异加固的合约验证。
AI.result: 九个前沿模型中最佳系统在WorldCoder-Core上仅达27.8%验证覆盖率，WorldCoder-Robust上为19.9%；失败主因是状态模式漂移和交互链断裂，而非场景元素缺失；廉价/快速模型在简单域上仍具实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM生成物理约束3D世界的能力仍有显著瓶颈，需要更好的状态管理和交互链保障机制；WorldCoder-Bench和StateProbe为后续研究提供了有效的评估框架。
idea_en: A method for automatically generating physically grounded 3D interactive worlds from natural language using LLMs, with runtime state verification via sandboxed execution probes.
A state-probing protocol (StateProbe) that injects mutation-hardened contracts into generated Three.js programs to verify hidden runtime state correctness and state transitions.
A benchmark system (WorldCoder-Bench) comprising 2,026 expert-curated 3D world synthesis tasks across Simulation, Rendering, and Application domains with behavioral contracts.
A technique for computing Return on Automation (RoA) and Time Efficiency Multiplier (TEM) to evaluate correctness-adjusted cost and time savings of LLM-generated 3D worlds.
A sandboxed browser-based verification framework that probes canvas-rendered 3D programs without requiring direct DOM access, enabling validation of hidden runtime states.
idea_ch: 一种利用大语言模型从自然语言自动生成受物理约束的、可交互3D世界的方法，并通过沙盒执行探针对运行时状态进行验证。
StateProbe协议：向生成的Three.js程序中注入变异加固的合约，验证隐藏的运行时状态正确性及状态转换的有效性。
WorldCoder-Bench基准系统：包含2,026个专家策划的3D世界合成任务，覆盖仿真、渲染和应用三大领域，并附带行为合约。
自动化回报率(RoA)和时间效率乘数(TEM)计算技术，用于评估LLM生成3D世界在正确性调整后的成本和时间节省。
一种基于沙盒浏览器的验证框架，可在不直接访问DOM的情况下探测canvas渲染的3D程序，实现对隐藏运行时状态的验证。

title: EVA-Net: Subject-Independent EEG Motor Decoding with Video-Derived Motor Priors
summary: Practical non-invasive Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems require EEG decoders with strong cross-subject generalization and minimal calibration. However, inter-subject variability and signal non-stationarity often entangle motor semantics with subject-specific noise, limiting subject-independent decoding. Recent multimodal approaches use text as a semantic anchor, yet text provides sparse and static supervision for inherently dynamic motor processes. To address this issue, we propose EVA-Net, a two-stage framework that uses action videos as semantic priors for subject-independent EEG motor decoding. In the first stage, EEG and video features are aligned in a shared space using cross-modal and supervised contrastive objectives to reduce subject-specific variation. In the second stage, video category prototypes and knowledge distillation transfer video-derived priors to an EEG-only classifier without adding inference overhead. Experiments on two public datasets show that EVA-Net achieves strong subject-independent decoding performance, including an 8.66% LOSO accuracy gain on EEGMMI. Ablation results further suggest that video provides a more effective semantic anchor than the text baseline considered in this work.

AI.tldr: EVA-Net是一个两阶段框架，利用动作视频作为语义先验，实现跨被试的EEG运动解码，无需额外推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG解码器受限于被试间差异和信号非平稳性，难以实现跨被试泛化；多模态方法使用文本作为语义锚点，但文本对动态运动过程的监督稀疏且静态。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过跨模态和监督对比学习对齐EEG与视频特征，减少被试特异性噪声；第二阶段利用视频类别原型和知识蒸馏，将视频先验迁移到仅EEG的分类器，无推理开销。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上实现强跨被试解码性能，EEGMMI数据集上LOSO准确率提升8.66%；消融实验表明视频比文本作为语义锚点更有效。
AI.conclusion: 视频作为动态语义先验比静态文本更有效，EVA-Net实现了无需校准的跨被试EEG运动解码。
idea_en: A two-stage EEG decoding framework using action video semantic priors for subject-independent motor decoding
Cross-modal and supervised contrastive learning to align EEG and video features for reducing subject-specific variation
Video category prototypes and knowledge distillation to transfer video-derived priors to EEG-only classifier without inference overhead
Using dynamic action videos as semantic anchors instead of static text for motor-related EEG decoding
idea_ch: 一种利用动作视频语义先验的两阶段EEG解码框架，实现跨被试运动解码
通过跨模态和监督对比学习对齐EEG与视频特征，减少被试特异性变异
利用视频类别原型和知识蒸馏技术，将视频先验迁移至仅EEG的分类器，且不增加推理开销
使用动态动作视频替代静态文本作为语义锚点，用于运动相关EEG解码

title: Absorbing Complexity: An Interaction-Native Knowledge Harness for Financial LLM Agents
summary:
Financial AI agents often fail for a simple reason: they make users carry the complexity. A user must repeatedly restate goals, risk preferences, portfolio context, past judgments, and shifting market assumptions, while the agent answers, retrieves, acts, and forgets. In finance, this is not just inconvenient. In tasks such as market analysis, copy-trading review, and trade preparation, forgotten context and stale memory can create latency, repeated errors, weak auditability, and unsafe decisions.
  We propose the interaction-native knowledge harness (InKH), an architecture for financial LLM agents that absorbs complexity into the system. InKH converts user, market, portfolio, and tool events into structured operational knowledge. It uses passive knowledge injection to assemble a bounded working context buffer before the main model step, temporal graph memory for low-latency retrieval, a wiki audit surface for human-readable governance, and background extraction with maturity, decay, and write-time invalidation.
  We evaluate InKH on a reproducible controlled synthetic benchmark with 24 random seeds, 4 rounds, 80 episodes per round, and 6 baselines, producing 46,080 baseline-conditioned evaluations. InKH achieves mean task quality of 0.815 at 900 ms latency. Compared with agent-driven wiki-walk memory, it reduces latency by 82.95 percent, token cost by 82.29 percent, and stale-knowledge usage by 96.58 percent, while improving quality by 0.108 and traceability by 0.461. Compared with a temporal-graph system without invalidation, it improves quality by 0.050 and reduces stale-memory usage by 96.58 percent with comparable serving cost.
  The results support a design thesis for financial AI: adoption happens when complexity is absorbed by the system rather than transferred to the user. The benchmark validates architecture-level behavior, not live trading performance.

AI.tldr: 提出交互原生知识框架（InKH），一种通过被动知识注入、时序图记忆、维基审计面板和过期失效机制，将金融AI代理中的用户复杂性吸收到系统中的架构，在合成基准测试中显著降低延迟、令牌成本和过时知识使用率。
AI.motivation: 金融AI代理因用户需反复陈述目标、风险偏好、投资组合和市场假设而频繁失败，且代理存在"回答、检索、行动、遗忘"的问题，导致延迟、重复错误、弱可审计性和不安全决策。
AI.method: InKH架构包含：(1)将用户、市场、投资组合和工具事件转化为结构化操作知识；(2)被动知识注入构建有界工作上下文缓冲；(3)时序图记忆实现低延迟检索；(4)维基审计面板提供可读治理；(5)后台提取机制含成熟度、衰减和写入时失效。
AI.result: 在24个随机种子、4轮、每轮80个回合、6个基线的合成基准测试（46,080次评估）中，InKH达到0.815任务质量@900ms延迟。相比agent驱动的维基漫步记忆，延迟降低82.95%，令牌成本降低82.29%，过时知识使用率降低96.58%，质量提升0.108，可追溯性提升0.461。
AI.conclusion: 金融AI的采纳关键在于系统吸收复杂性而非转嫁给用户。该基准验证了架构级行为，而非实盘交易性能。
idea_en: Interaction-native knowledge harness (InKH) architecture for financial LLM agents that converts user, market, portfolio, and tool events into structured operational knowledge
Passive knowledge injection mechanism that assembles a bounded working context buffer before the main model inference step
Temporal graph memory system with low-latency retrieval for financial agent context management
Wiki audit surface providing human-readable governance and traceability for financial AI decisions
Background extraction with maturity, decay, and write-time invalidation to prevent stale knowledge usage
Structured operational knowledge representation that eliminates repeated user restatement of goals, risk preferences, and portfolio context
Memory invalidation mechanism triggered at write time rather than read time for financial agent context
idea_ch: 交互原生知识框架（InKH）：一种将用户、市场、投资组合和工具事件转化为结构化操作知识的金融LLM代理架构
被动知识注入机制：在主模型推理步骤前自动组装有界工作上下文缓冲的技术
时序图记忆系统：为金融代理上下文管理提供低延迟检索的专利方法
维基审计面板：提供人类可读的治理和可追溯性的金融AI决策审计界面
后台知识提取机制：包含成熟度评估、衰减和写入时失效以防止使用过时知识
结构化操作知识表示方法：消除用户反复陈述目标、风险偏好和投资组合上下文的专利技术
写入时触发而非读取时触发的记忆失效机制：用于金融代理上下文管理的创新方法

title: Physically-Constrained Mamba-SDE for Remaining Useful Life Prediction under Irregular Observations
summary: Accurate Remaining Useful Life prediction is critical for industrial predictive maintenance. However, real-world deployment is challenging due to the irregular nature of sensor observations, characterized by asynchronous sampling, burst missingness, and temporal jitter. Compounding this issue, purely data-driven models often generate physically implausible degradation trajectories that violate the irreversible nature of damage accumulation. To address this, we propose PC-MambaSDE, a unified continuous-time framework for robust RUL prediction under irregular observations. Specifically, we design a Mask-Aware Continuous Mamba Encoder that explicitly leverages observation masks to extract context-rich control signals. Furthermore, we introduce a Physics-Guided Latent SDE with parametrically rectified hybrid drift, superimposing a global physical bias to enforce monotonic degradation even amid severe observation gaps. Additionally, we formulate RUL prediction as a boundary value problem via a Terminal Degradation Penalty, which decouples a Health Index dimension and applies a penalty loss to guide trajectories toward the failure state. Theoretically, we prove that our variational objective is mathematically equivalent to minimizing the KL divergence via Girsanov's theorem, and we guarantee the global asymptotic stability of the learned dynamics through Lyapunov analysis. To enable rigorous evaluation, we develop a Hybrid Irregularity Generation Scheme that simulates realistic industrial imperfections. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that PC-MambaSDE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under extreme observation scarcity, validating the efficacy of embedding physical priors into continuous-time latent dynamics.

AI.tldr: PC-MambaSDE是一个统一的连续时间框架，通过掩码感知的Mamba编码器、物理引导的潜在SDE和终端退化惩罚，解决了不规则观测下剩余寿命预测的物理不可靠性问题，在极端数据稀缺场景下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 工业预测维护中，传感器数据具有不规则特性（异步采样、突发缺失、时间抖动），且纯数据驱动模型常生成违反退化不可逆性的物理不可靠轨迹。
AI.method: 提出PC-MambaSDE框架，包含：1) 掩码感知连续Mamba编码器；2) 物理引导的潜在SDE（参数化整流混合漂移，叠加全局物理偏置强制执行单调退化）；3) 终端退化惩罚将RUL预测建模为边界值问题；4) 混合不规则性生成方案模拟真实工业缺陷。
AI.result: 在公共基准测试中显著超越SOTA方法，尤其在极端观测稀缺条件下表现突出，验证了将物理先验嵌入连续时间潜在动力学的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论证明（Girsanov定理的KL散度等价性、Lyapunov全局渐近稳定性分析）和实验验证，证明了物理引导的连续时间潜在模型在不规则观测下RUL预测的优越性。
idea_en: A mask-aware continuous Mamba encoder that explicitly leverages observation masks to extract context-rich control signals for irregular time-series data
A physics-guided latent stochastic differential equation (SDE) with parametrically rectified hybrid drift that superimposes a global physical bias to enforce monotonic degradation
A terminal degradation penalty mechanism that formulates RUL prediction as a boundary value problem by decoupling a health index dimension and guiding trajectories toward failure state
A hybrid irregularity generation scheme that simulates realistic industrial imperfections including asynchronous sampling, burst missingness, and temporal jitter
idea_ch: 一种掩码感知的连续Mamba编码器，通过显式利用观测掩码从不规则时间序列数据中提取富含上下文的控制信号
一种物理引导的潜在随机微分方程（SDE），采用参数化整流混合漂移，叠加全局物理偏置以强制执行单调退化行为

title: Community-Aware Assessment of Social Textual Engagement and Resonance: A Human-Centric Perspective on User-Generated Content Evaluation
comment: Published as a main conference paper at ACL 2026
summary: Traditional Video Quality Assessment (VQA) focuses narrowly on aesthetic fidelity, overlooking the complex social dynamics that define quality in User-Generated Content (UGC). In this work, we propose a paradigm shift from signal-centric metrics to human-centric resonance assessment. We introduce CASTER (Community-Aware Assessment of Social Textual Engagement and Resonance), a new task that evaluates whether a UGC item achieves positive community resonance based on its multimodal attributes rather than visual quality alone. To address this, we present MEDEA (Multimodal Engagement-Driven Evaluation Architecture), which introduces a novel Social Chain-of-Thought (Social-CoT) mechanism. Unlike traditional logical CoT, Social-CoT performs multimodal perspective-taking, instantiating diverse viewer personas to simulate collective cognitive and emotional reactions (i.e., the "community mind") before deriving a quality judgment. MEDEA is trained via a two-stage approach involving supervised fine-tuning and process-supervised reinforcement learning with Social Alignment Reward to ensure reasoning paths are grounded in authentic human social cognition. To support this task, we release CASTER-Bench, a comprehensive human-annotated benchmark covering diverse UGC categories. Experiments demonstrate that MEDEA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on CASTER-Bench while providing interpretable and empathetic reasoning paths that align with real community feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从传统信号质量评价转向社会共鸣评估，构建了CASTER任务和MEDEA架构，通过Social-CoT机制模拟多视角观众认知与情感反应来评估UGC的社区共鸣效果。
AI.motivation: 传统VQA只关注美学保真度，忽略了UGC中决定质量的关键社会动态因素（如社区互动、情感共鸣、社会参与度）。需要从信号中心指标转向人类中心共鸣评估。
AI.method: 1) 定义CASTER任务：评估UGC是否基于多模态属性实现正向社区共鸣。2) 提出MEDEA架构：核心为Social-Chain-of-Thought (Social-CoT)机制，模拟不同观众角色进行多模态视角切换，模拟"群体思维"。3) 两阶段训练：监督微调+过程监督强化学习，Social Alignment Reward确保推理路径符合真实社会认知。
AI.result: MEDEA在CASTER-Bench上显著优于现有基线方法，且提供可解释、共情的推理路径，与真实社区反馈高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 从信号保真度转向社会共鸣评估是UGC质量评估的正确方向，Social-CoT机制能有效模拟群体认知和情感反应，为下一代VQA提供了新范式。

Community resonance evaluation framework (CASTER) that assesses UGC quality based on social impact rather than aesthetic fidelity
Process-supervised reinforcement learning with Social Alignment Reward for training reasoning paths aligned with human social cognition
Multimodal Engagement-Driven Evaluation Architecture (MEDEA) combining visual, textual, and social cues for community-aware assessment
Multi-persona viewer simulation method that instantiates diverse viewer personas to simulate collective cognitive and emotional reactions
